confirmed_high.fix: Render a pool-detail card (remaining/total, claimed/maxClaims, min-max range, expiry countdown, status chip) bound to currentPool after inspect/create, plus compact recentPools and recentClaims lists on the activity side.

confirmed_high.title: Pool distribution journey is unreachable: share URL never shown and legacy ?pool= links can't claim
confirmed_high.evidence: currentShareUrl (derived at useGasLuckyPool.ts:146-158) is never displayed; buildLegacyPoolClaimUrl emits only '?pool=<id>' — PlayArea.tsx:102-106 gates the claim screen on launchClaimKey, so recipients of a pool link see the creator workspace with no claim button; the manifest operations panel also marks claimKey required, leaving claimRangeGasPool unreachable from any UI.
confirmed_high.fix: After create/inspect, render currentShareUrl with a copy button + QR; treat a poolId-only launch (?pool=) as a claim launch showing a 'Claim from pool #N' button that dispatches claimPool({ poolId }) (the composable's direct on-chain claim path already exists).

medium_low.title: Host operation panel method claimOneGateVault has no registered handler
medium_low.evidence: operation_panel declares method 'claimOneGateVault' but main.tsx registers claimPool/checkClaimStatus/loadPool/refundPool/topUpPool/loadGasCredit/withdrawGasCredit only; MiniAppRoot.tsx:409 silently console.warns on missing handlers, so the host-side primary button does nothing (the launch param path only special-cases the operation NAME, not the dispatch).
medium_low.fix: Register an alias in main.tsx: ctx.registerAction('claimOneGateVault', (form) => <same body as claimPool>) — one line reusing the existing handler.

medium_low.title: Hardcoded '1-50 GAS' and 'OneGate Vault' literals; derived currentRange unused
medium_low.evidence: 1-50 GAS and the h2/poolId fallback 'OneGate Vault' are TSX literals (untranslated, and the range duplicates the currentRange derived state which is bound nowhere), as is poolId: "OneGate Vault" in the congrats interpolation (lines 267-271).
medium_low.fix: Bind the range to str('currentRange') with the '1-50 GAS' default, and move 'OneGate Vault' into the locale (it already exists as the manifest name) for zh parity.

medium_low.title: Creator form gives caps only as submit-time errors
medium_low.evidence: maxClaims starts empty and expiry/slot caps (1-100 claims, ≤720 h, total ≥ min×claims) surface only as thrown validation errors after pressing Create; no helper text or input max attributes communicate them up-front.
medium_low.fix: Add max attributes (100 / 720) and a one-line helper under the row ('1-100 claims · up to 720h · total must cover min×claims'), and default maxClaims to a sensible value like 10.

purpose: FOMO pot game: every key purchase grows the pot and extends a countdown; the last buyer when the timer hits zero wins the entire pot.

journeys.name: buy keys in a live round
journeys.detail: BuyKeysCard -> dispatch('buyKeys') -> useLastSurvivor.buyKeys: reads currentKeyCost (authoritative, matches contract bonding-curve math), then GAS transfer with memo 'miniapp-lastsurvivor:buy', then buyKeys(player,count) with waitForEvent KeysBought, then loadAll refresh. ABI verified (buyKeys/settle/getCurrentRound/getRound all match). Friction: the two invokes have NO deposit-confirmation between them (the shared invokeWithPayment path exists precisely because intra-block ordering is fee/hash-based), so buyKeys can execute before the deposit lands and fault 'insufficient deposit credit'; the deposit then sits as contract credit. Also the deposit always sends the FULL cost without netting existing creditOf, so any prior stranded credit is never consumed.

journeys.name: settle expired round / winner payout
journeys.detail: needsLifecycleSync card -> dispatch('settleRound') -> settle() permissionless, waitForEvent RoundSettled, pays last buyer entire pot atomically (verified in MiniAppLastSurvivor.cs Settle). Friction: needsLifecycleSync requires !isRoundActive, but isRoundActive only updates on a chain refresh — when the local countdown hits 00:00:00 the UI still shows status 'Active' with Buy enabled until the user manually hits Refresh; the settle affordance never appears on its own.

journeys.name: withdraw stranded prepaid credit
journeys.detail: The deployed contract (0x8e1e432e..., verified on mainnet RPC) has withdraw(account) and creditOf(player), but the frontend never reads creditOf, never shows a credit balance, and has no withdraw control. The composable header even states 'there is no refund call (and none is needed)' — stale relative to the hardened contract. Money-in without money-out UI.

journeys.name: view past winners (history)
journeys.detail: loadHistory pages getRound for the last 30 finished rounds, lists winner + prize newest-first. Works; 30 parallel reads are unbounded Promise.all (red-envelope bounds concurrency at 8) but acceptable.

journeys.name: watch countdown / danger meter
journeys.detail: 1s ticker drives countdown/danger derivations correctly for live rounds. Friction: a FRESH round (totalKeys=0, the actual live mainnet state right now: round 1, pot 0) reports active=true with remainingTime 0, so the hero renders a pulsing red CRITICAL 00:00:00 ring — the idle-guard in DangerRingHero/DangerMeter only covers the inactive/no-data case, not the fresh-active case.

confirmed_high.title: Two-step buy lacks deposit confirmation before buyKeys (race strands funds)
confirmed_high.evidence: buyKeys issues chain.invoke('transfer', ... BUY_MEMO) and immediately chain.invoke('buyKeys', ...) with no confirmation between. The shared canonical path (useContractInteraction.invokeWithDirectPrepaidGas:408-414) explicitly confirms the deposit 'before firing the consuming call — intra-block ordering is fee/hash-based'. Red-envelope already does this correctly via waitForEvent:'Credited'.
confirmed_high.fix: Replace the manual two-step with chain.invokeWithPayment(costBase.toString(), BUY_MEMO, 'buyKeys', [player, count], { waitForEvent: 'KeysBought' }), or add { waitForEvent: 'Credited' } to the transfer invoke as apps/red-envelope/src/composables/useRedEnvelope.ts:636-645 does.

confirmed_high.title: No creditOf/withdraw UI — stranded deposit credit has no exit
confirmed_high.evidence: Comment claims 'there is no refund call (and none is needed)' but the deployed contract ABI (contracts/build/MiniAppLastSurvivor.manifest.json) has withdraw(account)->Integer and creditOf(player). The composable never reads creditOf, deposits the full cost regardless of existing credit (line 501-525), and PlayArea has no credit row or withdraw button — a failed buy leaves GAS permanently invisible to the user.
confirmed_high.fix: On loadAll read creditOf(playerHash) into a prepaidCredit observable; in buyKeys deposit only max(0, cost - credit); render a 'Prepaid credit: X GAS — Withdraw' row (mirror apps/red-envelope/src/PlayArea.tsx:397-410) dispatching withdraw(account) with waitForEvent 'CreditWithdrawn'.

medium_low.title: Round expiry never auto-detected: stale 'Active' status hides the Settle affordance and lets buys fault
medium_low.evidence: updateNow() only ticks the clock; isRoundActive/needsLifecycleSync flip only after loadRoundData. After local countdown reaches 0, canBuyKeys (PlayArea.tsx:72-73) stays true and the buyKeys pre-guard (line 480-485) is bypassed because isRoundActive is stale-true, so the deposit transfer is sent before buyKeys faults 'round ended; settle first'.
medium_low.fix: In the composable, detect the timeRemainingSeconds transition to 0 (while endTime>0) inside updateNow and trigger a one-shot loadAll(); additionally re-read getCurrentRound inside buyKeys before sending the deposit transfer.

medium_low.title: Fresh round renders pulsing red CRITICAL 00:00:00 (current live mainnet state)
medium_low.evidence: DangerRingHero/DangerMeter receive active={isRoundActive && roundDataAvailable}; a fresh round (totalKeys=0) is active=true with remainingTime 0 (RoundMap in MiniAppLastSurvivor.cs), so dangerLevel='critical' + shouldPulse renders an alarming red state. Mainnet getCurrentRound right now returns roundId 1, pot 0, totalKeys 0 — every first-time user sees this.
medium_low.fix: Pass active={isRoundActive && roundDataAvailable && totalKeys > 0} to both components and show an 'Awaiting the first key — buying starts the clock' caption in the ring when totalKeys === 0.

medium_low.title: Rules copy contradicts the contract (platform fees, diminishing time, 24h reset)
medium_low.evidence: ruleWinDesc says winner gets the pool 'after platform fees' (zh: 扣除平台费用后) — Settle() pays the ENTIRE pot, no fee. ruleTimerDesc says 'Later bids add less time' — the contract adds a constant 30s/key (EXTEND_PER_KEY_MS=30_000), only capped at 24h. neo-manifest.json description_zh says every contribution '重置24小时倒计时' (resets 24h) — it extends by 30s/key.
medium_low.fix: Rewrite ruleTimerDesc/ruleWinDesc (and docDescription/step2 + neo-manifest.json description_zh) to match the contract: '+30 seconds per key, capped at 24h; the last buyer wins the entire pot, no fee'.

medium_low.title: Current leader shown as truncated script-hash hex, no self-recognition
medium_low.evidence: lastBuyer arrives as parseByteLike's '0x<hex>' little-endian script hash (shared/utils/neo.ts:43-48) and is sliced 6...4 — players cannot recognise themselves as leader or compare with their wallet address.
medium_low.fix: Convert with scriptHashToAddress for display and compare against addressToScriptHash(connected address) to render a 'You' badge on the leader card when it matches.

medium_low.title: Dead locale keys and dead English fallbacks left from the kernel era
medium_low.evidence: keyPurchaseRefunded, keyPurchaseRecoveryNeeded, lifecycleManaged, buyKeysAndRollover, buyKeysRolloverHint are no longer referenced; PlayArea.tsx carries unreachable `t(key) || "English"` fallbacks (e.g. lines 140, 173, 176, 203).
medium_low.fix: Delete the unused keys and the dead || fallbacks (all referenced keys exist in both en and zh).

medium_low.title: Stale runtime.modules metadata points at retired PlatformGame kernel ops and old hashes
medium_low.evidence: runtime.modules still declares PlatformGame operations (startCountdownRound/buyCountdownKeys/checkAndEndCountdownRound) and hashes 0xa7840a8d/0xe2385169 while the app actually drives 0x8e1e432e via contracts{}; the keeper claim ('Auto-triggers prize distribution') no longer matches the permissionless manual settle flow.
medium_low.fix: Remove the obsolete runtime.modules block (or repoint it at the standalone contract) and update technologies.keeper to describe the permissionless settle.

purpose: Pay 0.1 GAS and have the contract draw three distinct Past/Present/Future tarot cards on-chain via Runtime.GetRandom, auditable from the ReadingDrawn event.

journeys.name: ask a question and draw 3 cards
journeys.detail: Question textarea -> dispatch('draw') -> useTarot.draw: reads drawFee() and creditOf(player), tops up ONLY the missing fee via GAS transfer with memo 'miniapp-tarot:draw', then draw(player) with waitForEvent ReadingDrawn; card indices parsed from event slots 2-4 with a getReading(readingId) fallback and strict 3-distinct-valid validation. ABI verified against MiniAppTarot.manifest.json; contract 0xb680225a confirmed deployed on mainnet. Only residual risk is the unconfirmed-deposit race (no Credited wait), which the credit-reuse logic recovers from on the next draw.

journeys.name: reveal cards, read and copy the summary
journeys.detail: Tap-to-flip per slot, summary card appears once all three are flipped, copyReading guards against incomplete spreads and only confirms after a real clipboard write. Clean.

journeys.name: review past readings
journeys.detail: The contract supports playerReadingCount + getPlayerReadings + getReading; the composable persists each question on-device keyed by readingId explicitly 'so the history can surface it' and defines HISTORY_PAGE_LIMIT — but no history UI exists anywhere in PlayArea, and marketing copy (feature3Desc) promises 'Past readings are stored on-chain and can be replayed'. restoreQuestion is exported and never called.

journeys.name: withdraw prepaid draw credit
journeys.detail: withdraw(account) exists in the ABI but has no UI. Impact is low (max one 0.1 GAS fee, auto-reused on the next draw since draw() checks creditOf first), but a user who deposits and never draws again has no exit.

medium_low.title: Reading history UI missing despite contract support, on-device question store, and marketing promise
medium_low.evidence: HISTORY_PAGE_LIMIT=100 and QUESTION_KEY_PREFIX are defined, persistQuestion/restoreQuestion are implemented, the ABI exposes getPlayerReadings(player,offset,limit) — yet PlayArea.tsx renders no history list, and messages.ts:120-124 (feature3Desc) tells users 'Past readings are stored on-chain and can be replayed via getReading'.
medium_low.fix: Add a 'Past readings' card: page getPlayerReadings(playerHash, max(0,count-10), 10) on loadAll, map each id through getReading + restoreQuestion(readingId), and render question + three card names per row with a tap-to-reload-into-spread action.

medium_low.title: Deposit-then-draw lacks deposit confirmation (first-draw failure mode)
medium_low.evidence: When credit < fee the transfer invoke is not awaited for confirmation (no waitForEvent:'Credited', no confirmDeposit) before draw(player) is sent — draw can land first and fault, surfacing 'depositPrepaidNoReading' on what should have been a clean first draw.
medium_low.fix: Add { waitForEvent: 'Credited' } to the transfer options (pattern: apps/red-envelope/src/composables/useRedEnvelope.ts:636-645) or switch to chain.invokeWithPayment.

medium_low.title: Event-timeout recovery dead-ends: readingId 0 -> getReading(0) -> raw 'reading not found'
medium_low.evidence: If waitForEvent times out, result.event is null, readingId parses to '0', normalizeReadingCards throws, and the fallback readReadingCards('0') throws the untranslated 'reading not found' even though the draw succeeded on-chain.
medium_low.fix: When the event is missing, resolve the latest reading via playerReadingCount(player) then getPlayerReadings(player, count-1, 1) and getReading(thatId); only fail with a localized message if that also misses.

medium_low.title: The user's question vanishes the moment cards arrive
medium_low.evidence: question.set('') clears the textarea right after the draw, and neither the spread panel nor the reading summary re-displays the question the reading answers — it is persisted on-device but never shown.
medium_low.fix: Keep an activeQuestion observable set from the prompt at draw time and render it above the spread / in the summary card ('You asked: ...').

medium_low.title: 'Readings' metric silently switches between player count and global count
medium_low.evidence: loadReadingCount returns playerReadingCount when a wallet is connected but global readingsCount otherwise, under the same 'Readings' label — the number can drop from e.g. 941 to 3 on wallet connect with no explanation.
medium_low.fix: Bind two labelled stats (yourReadings / totalReadings) or change the label text reactively when the wallet-connected source is used.

medium_low.title: 'Oracle verified' / 'Oracle sealed' status labels misdescribe the post-migration mechanism
medium_low.evidence: oracleVerifiedShort ('Oracle verified') and oracleSealed are leftovers from the oracle era; the long-form copy correctly says Runtime.GetRandom with no oracle, so the short labels contradict the body copy.
medium_low.fix: Rename to 'On-chain verified' / 'Sealed' (en+zh) to match the verificationPanelCopy and docDescription wording.

purpose: All-pay seasonal contest: burn GAS into the season pool, climb the leaderboard, and the top burner wins the whole pool when the season is settled.

journeys.name: burn GAS into the season (including starting a dormant season)
journeys.detail: Amount input with presets/min-max validation -> dispatch('burn') -> useBurnLeague.burnTokens: strict decimal parse, single base-unit scaling, creditOf shortfall check, transfer with memo 'miniapp-burnleague:burn', burn(player,amount) with waitForEvent Burned, post-burn loadAll. ABI verified. Friction: (1) the success toast key 'burnSuccess' does not exist so the primary action confirms with a BLANK toast in production; (2) no deposit confirmation between transfer and burn; (3) the first mainnet burn silently starts a 2-MINUTE season (verified live: seasonDuration()=120000ms, currentSeason=0) and nothing in the UI discloses season length.

journeys.name: track season status and leaderboard
journeys.detail: Season banner derives dormant/active/ended from seasonEnd + 1s ticker (correctly time-local, so 'ended' appears without manual refresh — better than last-survivor), shows countdown, prize pool, leader; leaderboard rebuilt from current-season Burned events (latest userSeasonTotal per player). With the events indexer back up this is live.

journeys.name: settle ended season (winner payout)
journeys.detail: Ended phase shows 'Settle season' button -> settle() permissionless with waitForEvent SeasonSettled, whole pool to top burner, then refresh. Burns are correctly blocked during the ended phase with an explanatory notice.

journeys.name: withdraw unused burn credit
journeys.detail: The contract has withdraw(account) (ABI verified) and the burnDepositHeld message tells users their GAS 'was deposited as reusable burn credit... no funds were lost', but there is no credit display or withdraw control anywhere in the UI.

journeys.name: claim rank-based seasonal rewards (as promised by the copy)
journeys.detail: steps/features copy promises 'Claim your seasonal rewards based on final ranking' and 'Earn seasonal rewards based on your burn contribution' — the contract is strictly winner-takes-all (whole pool to the single top burner; everyone else loses 100% of what they burned). No claim journey exists or can exist; the copy materially misrepresents the payout.

confirmed_high.title: 2-minute mainnet seasons are never disclosed — users burn into a round whose length they cannot see
confirmed_high.evidence: Live mainnet read: seasonDuration()=120000ms, currentSeason=0 (dormant). The contract exposes seasonDuration() but loadStats never reads it; seasonDormantHint (messages.ts:48-51) says only 'the first burn starts a fresh season'. A first burner unknowingly opens a 120-second winner-takes-all round.
confirmed_high.fix: Read seasonDuration() in loadStats into a seasonDurationMs observable and render 'Season length: {humanized}' in the dormant hint and the active banner; (separately recommend the planned contract redeploy with a 7-day season for mainnet).

medium_low.title: Marketing copy promises rank-based rewards; the contract is winner-takes-all
medium_low.evidence: docDescription ('earn points, and win exclusive rewards'), step4 ('Claim your seasonal rewards based on final ranking'), feature3Desc ('Earn seasonal rewards based on your burn contribution') all imply tiered payouts. Settle() pays the WHOLE pool to the single top burner; non-leaders lose everything they burned. The in-app season banner says this correctly — the doc copy contradicts it.
medium_low.fix: Rewrite docDescription/step4/feature3Desc (en+zh) to state the all-pay winner-takes-all model plainly: 'Only the season's top burner wins the entire pool; all other burns are forfeited to the pool.'

medium_low.title: Deposit-then-burn lacks deposit confirmation before burn()
medium_low.evidence: The transfer invoke has no waitForEvent:'Credited'/confirmDeposit before burn(player,amount) is sent, so the burn can land first and fault, downgrading a clean burn into the 'burnDepositHeld' recovery message (race the shared invokeWithDirectPrepaidGas:408-414 exists to prevent).
medium_low.fix: Add { waitForEvent: 'Credited' } to the transfer options or use chain.invokeWithPayment(amountBase.toString(), BURN_MEMO, 'burn', args, { waitForEvent: 'Burned' }).

medium_low.title: No credit balance / withdraw UI despite the contract's withdraw() and copy referencing it
medium_low.evidence: Composable doc says credit is 'reclaimable via withdraw' and burnDepositHeld reassures 'no funds were lost', but creditOf is only read transiently inside burnTokens; no observable, no display, no withdraw dispatch exists.
medium_low.fix: Track prepaidCredit (read creditOf in loadStats), and when > 0 render a recovery row with a 'Withdraw credit' button dispatching withdraw(account) with waitForEvent 'CreditWithdrawn' — mirror apps/red-envelope/src/PlayArea.tsx:397-410.

medium_low.title: Projected rank ignores the user's existing season total
medium_low.evidence: projectedPosition counts leaderboard entries with burned > currentBurnAmountNumber — only the NEW amount. A user who already burned 10 GAS adding 5 GAS is ranked as if their total were 5, while the adjacent 'Projected total' correctly shows 15. The two stats contradict each other in the same strip.
medium_low.fix: Compare entries against (userBurned + currentBurnAmountNumber), excluding the user's own leaderboard entry from the count; expose userBurned as a number binding for this.

medium_low.title: Every refresh (including post-burn) replaces the whole UI with a full-screen spinner
medium_low.evidence: if (isLoading) returns a bare spinner page; burnTokens' finally runs loadAll which sets isLoading, so after every burn/settle the entire layout (form, banner, leaderboard) unmounts and remounts, losing scroll position.
medium_low.fix: Gate the full-screen loader to first load only (isLoading && !leagueDataAvailable); during re-loads keep content rendered with a small inline refresh indicator on the season banner.

medium_low.title: Leaderboard amounts rendered as raw floats
medium_low.evidence: {entry.burned} GAS prints the unformatted fromBaseUnits number (e.g. '12.30000000000001 GAS' is possible after float division), while every other amount goes through formatNumber.
medium_low.fix: Use the already-exported formatNum(entry.burned) from useBurnLeague.ts:674.

purpose: Claim-first GAS red envelopes for OneGate QR links: fund a total, split into N random packets paid atomically to claimers, with reclaim of expired remainders.

journeys.name: create (send) a red envelope
journeys.detail: Create tab validates amount/packets/per-packet/expiry with inline reasons -> create(): reads creditOf, deposits only the SHORTFALL with memo 'miniapp-redenvelope:create' AND waits for the 'Credited' event before createEnvelope (the only app of the four that closes the intra-block race), waitForEvent EnvelopeCreated, full refresh. ABI verified. Friction: the success toast key 'envelopeCreated' is undefined (blank toast), and the created envelope id is never surfaced (see share journey).

journeys.name: share the envelope (QR / deep link) so recipients can claim
journeys.detail: The manifest's whole premise is 'claim-first GAS red envelopes for OneGate QR links' and the hero badge says 'OneGate share-ready', but after creating there is NO share affordance at all: the EnvelopeCreated result is discarded (the new envId is never captured), no id/copy-link/QR/deeplink (neomainapp://red-envelope?envelopeId=N) is shown, and the creator must deduce their envelope id from the first row of the global list. The distribution journey the product is named for cannot be completed from the UI.

journeys.name: claim a packet (deep link or manual id)
journeys.detail: Launch params (envelopeId/poolId/id/packet) prefill the claim field; claim(): hasClaimed pre-guard with clean 'already opened' message, claim(envId,claimer) waitForEvent Claimed, share parsed from event with claimedAmount fallback, lucky-money modal, SURGICAL single-envelope refresh + local claim append. Solid. Minor gap: with a launch id, loadData skips loadAll so the claimer sees no envelope facts (remaining packets, expiry, creator) before signing.

journeys.name: reclaim expired remainder (creator)
journeys.detail: reclaimable flag (active && expired && remainder>0 && creator==me) renders a recovery row -> reclaim(envId,creator) waitForEvent Reclaimed with amount toast. Friction: reclaimables are derived only from the newest-30 GLOBAL envelope page; once 30 newer envelopes exist, a creator's older expired envelope disappears from the UI and getCreatorEnvelopes (in the ABI precisely for this) is never called — the funds become UI-unreachable.

journeys.name: withdraw unused prepaid credit
journeys.detail: prepaidCredit observable refreshes with every load, recovery panel shows the balance with a Withdraw button -> withdraw(account) waitForEvent CreditWithdrawn, pre-checked against 'no credit' revert with a localized message. This is the reference implementation the other three games should copy.

confirmed_high.title: No share affordance after create — the core OneGate-QR distribution journey is missing
confirmed_high.evidence: await chain.invoke('createEnvelope', ..., { waitForEvent: 'EnvelopeCreated' }) discards the result, so the new envId (event state[0]) is lost; PlayArea.tsx has no share/copy-link/QR UI and locale/messages.ts has no share keys, despite neo-manifest.json describing 'claim-first GAS red envelopes for OneGate QR links' and the hero 'OneGate share-ready' label.
confirmed_high.fix: Capture envId from the EnvelopeCreated event, store a lastCreatedEnvelope observable, and render a post-create success card showing '#id', a copy button for the deeplink (neomainapp://red-envelope?envelopeId=N via ctx.services.clipboard), and a QR (the platform share sheet if available).

medium_low.title: Success toast keys 'envelopeCreated' / 'envelopeClaimed' are undefined — blank toasts in production
medium_low.evidence: Both notify.guard success keys are absent from apps/red-envelope/src/locale/messages.ts and apps/shared/locale/base-messages.ts; useI18n.ts:133 returns '' for missing keys in production. Claim is partially saved by the lucky modal, but create's only confirmation is the blank toast plus a silent list refresh.
medium_low.fix: Add envelopeCreated/envelopeClaimed entries (en+zh) to messages.ts, or point the guards at existing keys; cover dispatch success keys in the i18n parity test.

medium_low.title: Reclaimable envelopes vanish from the UI once they fall off the newest-30 global page
medium_low.evidence: loadEnvelopes pages only lastEnvelopeId() backwards by ENVELOPE_PAGE_SIZE=30 global ids; PlayArea.tsx:175 filters reclaimables from that page. getCreatorEnvelopes(creator,offset,limit) exists in the ABI but is never called, so a creator's expired envelope older than the newest 30 becomes unreachable for reclaim through the UI.
medium_low.fix: When a wallet is connected, additionally read getCreatorEnvelopes(creatorHash, 0, LIST_PAGE_LIMIT), readEnvelope each id not already in the page, and merge creator-owned envelopes into the reclaimables source.

medium_low.title: Deep-link claimers see no envelope facts before signing
medium_low.evidence: With a launch envelopeId, loadData only sets the address and skips loadAll, so envelopes=[] and targetEnvelope is undefined — the selected-card block (remaining packets, progress) never renders and the QR recipient claims blind (no amount, creator, or expiry shown).
medium_low.fix: In the launch-id branch, perform the cheap surgical read (composable readEnvelope(launchId, claimerHash), 2 RPC reads) and seed it into envelopes so the claim tab shows the envelope's facts before the wallet prompt.

medium_low.title: Claim button stays enabled for envelopes already known to be unclaimable
medium_low.evidence: disabled={isLoading || !selectedEnvelopeId.trim()} ignores targetEnvelope.canOpen/expired/depleted that the app already computed — a user selecting a depleted envelope gets a wallet-path failure instead of an upfront explanation.
medium_low.fix: When targetEnvelope exists and !targetEnvelope.canOpen, disable the button and set the helper text to the specific reason (expired / all packets opened / already claimed) from the mapped flags.

medium_low.title: Claim rows show raw script-hash ids and a hardcoded English 'Wallet' fallback
medium_low.evidence: claim.holder is the claimer script hash ('0x...'), rendered via shortId; the fallback literal "Wallet" bypasses t(); since these are always the connected wallet's own claims, the hash adds noise.
medium_low.fix: Label the rows with the envelope id ('#{poolId}') plus a localized 'You' (add a key), dropping the raw holder hash and the hardcoded fallback.

purpose: Marketplace for governance voting power: stake NEO into a shared pool, mercenaries bid GAS per 5-minute epoch to route the pooled influence, stakers earn the auction revenue pro-rata.

journeys.name: Stake NEO
journeys.detail: Deposit NEO → transfer to contract with memo govmerc:stake (NEO kept integer, never x1e8) → waits for Staked event → full reload. Pre-validated (enterNeoAmount), hooks/useGovMerc.ts:435-466 matches deployed v2 ABI (verified epochDuration()=300000 on mainnet 0x140f5faf).

journeys.name: Withdraw staked NEO
journeys.detail: withdrawStake(user, amount) with over-balance pre-check both in the hook (useGovMerc.ts:477) and at the button (MercActionCards.tsx:37-39 shows withdrawExceeds inline).

journeys.name: Place/raise GAS bid inside the v2 window
journeys.detail: Deposit-then-act: tops up credit only when gasCreditOf < amount, waits for Credited event before bid(), mirrors min-bid and the contract's 'bidding closed' revert with distinct credit-held messaging (biddingClosedCreditHeld). Friction: the first-bid-vs-raise distinction (min 1 GAS) relies on the event-derived leaderboard; if the events feed degrades (see shared finding) a small raise is wrongly blocked as a first bid.

journeys.name: Settle epoch (route governance)
journeys.detail: settleEpoch() permissionless; UI correctly unlocks only after the countdown ends (canSettleNow = canSettle && biddingClosed, PlayArea.tsx:80) with hint copy for both gates. But canSettle derives solely from BidPlaced events — if the events feed is empty/stale the settle button never enables even though the contract has highestBid>0.

journeys.name: Claim staker rewards
journeys.detail: pendingRewards(user) read (base units ÷1e8), claimRewards waits RewardsClaimed, affordance always visible with empty-state hint (MercStakerPanel.tsx:47-64).

journeys.name: Reclaim losing bid
journeys.detail: Losers work (bidOf scan over 12 epochs, reclaimBid waits BidReclaimed). But the winner-exclusion guard compares the contract's hex script-hash against the base58 wallet address — never matches — so every epoch a user WINS leaves a phantom 'reclaimable' row; clicking it reverts on-chain with the raw 'winner cannot reclaim' message.

journeys.name: Withdraw unused GAS bid credit
journeys.detail: withdraw(account) wired with gasCreditOf display and disabled state when zero — the deposit-then-act escape hatch is fully exposed (MercStakerPanel.tsx:99-109).

confirmed_high.title: Shared events client cannot parse the live N3Index envelope — all event-driven UI degrades
confirmed_high.evidence: createEventsComposable.list() does `const data = await res.json(); if (Array.isArray(data))` (lines ~333-349), but the live API now wraps every response in an envelope — verified by curl: GET .../contracts/0x140f5faf.../events returns {"data":[],"paging":{...}} and even /status returns {"data":{...}}. The Array.isArray check fails, so the N3Index path silently never yields events and everything falls back to the platform API (empty when VITE_PLATFORM_API is unset). In gov-merc this empties the bid leaderboard, disables settle (canSettle = bids.length>0), hides reclaimables, and makes every waitForEvent ('Staked','Credited','BidPlaced','EpochSettled') burn its full 10s timeout. Same degradation hits dev-tipping's recent-tips feed and registration devId resolution — reported once here per instructions.
confirmed_high.fix: In list(), unwrap the envelope: `const body = await res.json(); const rows = Array.isArray(body) ? body : Array.isArray(body?.data) ? body.data : null; if (rows) return { events: rows.map(...) }`. Also update n3index.ts apiFetch consumers (getContractEvents, getNetworkStatus) for the same {data} envelope.

medium_low.title: Settle gate derives only from event feed, not from the contract's highestBid
medium_low.evidence: Lines 59-63: canSettle = pool.bids.get().length > 0, where bids is rebuilt exclusively from BidPlaced events (useGovMerc.ts:301-324). If the indexer lags or the events client fails (see shared finding), settlement becomes unreachable from the UI even though the contract read highestBid(epoch) > 0 proves it is settleable — bids would sit locked until someone settles externally.
medium_low.fix: In loadStats() also read `highestBid(currentEpoch)` and feed a hasLiveBid observable; canSettle = events-derived bids.length > 0 || highestBidBase > 0n.

medium_low.title: Last-settled winner rendered as raw little-endian hex while the leaderboard shows wallet addresses
medium_low.evidence: Lines 66-79: lastSettlementDisplay truncates `s.winner` (e.g. '0x3837f4...066d', the LE byte order which no explorer accepts) while MercBidsList shows base58 addresses from decoded events — the same identity appears in two unrecognizable formats.
medium_low.fix: Convert in loadSettlement: winner = scriptHashToAddress(addressToScriptHash(winnerRaw)) (shared utils/neo.ts has both helpers), falling back to the hex only if conversion fails.

medium_low.title: Token symbols hardcoded in components instead of tokenNeo/tokenGas locale keys
medium_low.evidence: MercHeroStats.tsx:21 `{formatNum(totalPool, 0)} NEO` and MercBidsList.tsx:32 `{formatNum(bid.amount, 2)} GAS` bypass the existing tokenNeo/tokenGas keys that the rest of the app (main.tsx:43, MercStakerPanel) uses.
medium_low.fix: Pass t() through and render `${formatNum(...)} ${t("tokenNeo")}` / `${t("tokenGas")}` for consistency with the staker panel.

purpose: Participate in DAO governance: council candidates create text/policy proposals, vote, and finalize them; everyone can browse on-chain and neo.community proposals.

journeys.name: Browse proposals
journeys.detail: Testnet: getProposalCount (13 live, verified by RPC) → newest-100 getProposalDetails fan-out with per-id error tolerance; mainnet: neo.community explorer mirror. Skeleton rows + spinner note while loading, empty states with guidance, active/history tabs with counts.

journeys.name: Create proposal (candidate)
journeys.detail: Form validates title/description/policy integer (regex pre-flight saves gas), createProposal args verified against the deployed mainnet ABI. BUT on mainnet (default network) loadProposals early-returns once the explorer mirror has any data (useGovernance.ts:410-412), so the freshly created on-chain proposal never appears in the list — the creator reasonably concludes the creation failed. Works fully on testnet.

journeys.name: Vote for/against
journeys.detail: Candidate-gated with a clear access banner (connectWalletReadOnly / readOnlyReason / eligibleToVote) and hasVoted dedupe; vote(voter,proposalId,support) matches the deployed ABI; refreshes proposals + hasVoted after the tx. On mainnet, however, only read-only neo.community proposals are ever listed (same explorer-first bug), so there is nothing votable.

journeys.name: Finalize passed proposal
journeys.detail: Details panel shows Finalize only for statusKey 'passed'; the contract computes statusString dynamically (verified live: an expired-no-quorum proposal returns status 5 / 'expired'), so quorum-passed proposals do surface the button, and finalizeProposal(proposalId) matches the ABI.

journeys.name: Execute passed policy proposal
journeys.detail: The deployed contract has BOTH finalizeProposal and executeProposal (applies the PolicyContract change), but the composable aliases executeProposal: finalizeProposal (useGovernance.ts:539) — the real execution step can never be invoked, so policy proposals can pass but never take effect from this UI.

journeys.name: Revoke own proposal
journeys.detail: revokeProposal(creator, proposalId) exists on the deployed contract (verified in mainnet ABI) but no UI control or action dispatches it — a creator cannot withdraw a mistaken proposal.

confirmed_high.title: Mainnet explorer-first early return hides all contract proposals (create/vote dead on the default network)
confirmed_high.evidence: Lines 410-412: `if (resolveNetwork(...) === 'mainnet') { const explorerLoaded = await loadExplorerProposals(); if (explorerLoaded && proposals.get().length > 0) return; }` — whenever the neo.community mirror returns anything, on-chain proposals are never read. createProposal() then calls loadProposals() after the tx (line 394), which re-shows only the read-only mirror, so the creator's new proposal is invisible and every listed proposal rejects votes with externalProposalReadOnly. default_network is neo-n3-mainnet.
confirmed_high.fix: Merge instead of short-circuit: load contract proposals and explorer proposals, concatenate (contract entries first), dedupe by source, and sort. Keep the explorer call as enrichment, not a replacement.

medium_low.title: executeProposal action is aliased to finalizeProposal — policy execution unreachable
medium_low.evidence: Line 539: `executeProposal: finalizeProposal` while the deployed contract ABI (mainnet 0xc7e50e67, verified via getcontractstate) exposes a separate executeProposal(proposalId) that applies the proposal's PolicyContract change. The details panel's only lifecycle button calls dispatch('executeProposal') → finalizeProposal. A passed policy proposal can be finalized but its on-chain effect can never be triggered from the app.
medium_low.fix: Add a real executeProposal(proposalId) invoking the contract's executeProposal, and in PlayArea show 'Execute' for statusKey 'passed'||'executed'-pending policy proposals after finalization (statusString from getProposalDetails distinguishes the states).

medium_low.title: No UI for revokeProposal (creator cancel)
medium_low.evidence: The deployed contract exposes revokeProposal(creator, proposalId) (mainnet ABI verified) and statusKeyFor already maps 'revoked' (useGovernance.ts:135), but no button/action exists — a candidate who creates a wrong proposal has no exit and it stays votable until expiry.
medium_low.fix: In the details panel, when selectedProposal.statusKey === 'active' and creator matches the connected wallet, show a 'Revoke proposal' (danger) button dispatching a new revokeProposal action → invokeContract('revokeProposal', [Hash160 address, Integer id]).

medium_low.title: Proposal creator displayed as raw little-endian hex script hash
medium_low.evidence: Line 394 `{t("creator")}: {shortAddress(proposal.creator)}` — getProposalDetails returns creator as a Hash160 ByteString that parses to '0x561cc063…' (verified by decoding testnet proposal #1), a little-endian form that no explorer accepts; explorer-mirrored proposals show human names, making the contract rows look broken by comparison.
medium_low.fix: In parseProposal, convert: creator = scriptHashToAddress(addressToScriptHash(asString(data.creator))) || asString(data.creator), then shortAddress renders a recognizable N-address.

medium_low.title: hasVoted reads issued for synthetic explorer-proposal ids
medium_low.evidence: refreshHasVoted (lines 486-509) iterates activeProposals including neo-community entries whose ids are synthetic char-code sums (line 217) and fires hasVoted contract reads for each — wasted RPC round-trips on every wallet change, and a synthetic id could collide with a real contract id, mislabeling it 'already voted'.
medium_low.fix: Filter to contract-sourced proposals: `const ids = (proposalIds ?? activeProposals.get().filter(p => p.source !== 'neo-community').map(p => p.id));` and namespace external ids (e.g. negative ids) to avoid collisions in hasVotedMap.

purpose: Run quadratic funding rounds with public matching pools: creators fund a matching pool, projects register, donors contribute, the round finalizes with matched payouts projects can claim.

journeys.name: Create round (with matching pool)
journeys.detail: Doubly broken on-chain. (1) The contract consumes prepaid credit (ConsumeDirectAssetCredit) that must be deposited via a NEP-17 transfer with memo 'miniapp-quadratic-funding:*' BEFORE the call, but the UI does a bare invokeDirectly — proven by mainnet invokefunction simulation: FAULT 'insufficient prepaid asset'. (2) parseDateInput returns SECONDS while the contract clock and stored rounds are MILLISECONDS (mainnet round 1 stores startTime 1778242209689), so even with credit the call reverts 'end time in past'.

journeys.name: Add matching (sponsor top-up)
journeys.detail: Same missing deposit leg (addMatchingPool → ConsumeDirectAssetCredit revert), and the button is permanently disabled anyway because canManageSelectedRound compares the contract's hex creator to the base58 wallet address (always false).

journeys.name: Register project
journeys.detail: registerProject(owner,roundId,name,desc,link) needs only the owner witness and matches the ABI; works when a round is selected. Friction: depends on a round existing (the create-round journey being broken means new rounds only appear via external/gateway tooling), and the projects tab hint relies on selecting a round in another tab first.

journeys.name: Contribute to a project
journeys.detail: contribute() also consumes prepaid credit — bare invoke reverts 'insufficient prepaid asset'. Good input validation (NEO-indivisible check, regex) is wasted because the happy path cannot land. 'Contribute now' on a project card does prefill the project id nicely.

journeys.name: Finalize round with matched amounts
journeys.detail: Triple-gated failure: UI enables it only for the round creator (identity comparison always false → disabled), the contract actually requires the platform ADMIN witness (Methods.cs:193 CheckWitness(Admin())) so a creator would revert 'unauthorized', and the inputs are hand-typed parallel JSON arrays with no quadratic-match computation.

journeys.name: Claim project payout (owner)
journeys.detail: canClaimProject does project.owner === address.get() (hex vs base58, always false) so claimableProjectIds is always empty and the Claim button never renders — even for a finalized round with matched funds (mainnet has exactly this: round 1 finalized, project 1 matched 0.05 GAS).

journeys.name: Claim unused matching (creator)
journeys.detail: Same identity-comparison bug keeps canClaimUnused false forever; mainnet round 1 has 0.15 GAS matchingRemaining stranded behind this dead button.

journeys.name: Cancel round / refund matching sponsors
journeys.detail: cancelRound and refundMatchingPoolContribution exist in the repo contract but have no UI at all — and the DEPLOYED mainnet contract (35 methods) predates refundMatchingPoolContribution entirely, so sponsor refunds are impossible until a redeploy.

confirmed_high.title: Round times sent in seconds but the contract clock is milliseconds; displayed dates multiplied 1000x
confirmed_high.evidence: createRound uses parseDateInput (shared/utils/parsers.ts:27 returns Math.floor(ms/1000) = SECONDS) for startTime/endTime, but Neo Runtime.Time and the deployed contract store MILLISECONDS (mainnet round 1: startTime=1778242209689). A seconds value always fails `endTime > Runtime.Time` → revert 'end time in past'. Conversely formatSchedule (lines 382-387) does `new Date(startTime * 1000)` on stored ms → round cards render dates in year ~58,000.
confirmed_high.fix: Send ms: use Date.parse directly (or parseDateInput(...) * 1000) for createRound args, and render with new Date(startTime) (no *1000) in formatSchedule and PlayArea.tsx:130.

medium_low.title: Finalize UX requires hand-typed parallel JSON arrays instead of computed quadratic matches
medium_low.evidence: Lines 33-44: two free-text inputs expect '[1,2]' and '["1.5","0.5"]' JSON; a typo or length mismatch is only caught by a generic 'invalidRound' toast. The app never computes the quadratic match (sum-of-sqrt of contributions) although it already loads every project's totalContributed/contributorCount — the core value proposition is delegated to the operator's calculator.
medium_low.fix: Compute suggested matches client-side: weight_i = (Σ√c_ij)², match_i = matchingPool * weight_i / Σweights, render an editable preview table (project, contributed, suggested match) and build the arrays from it; keep raw-JSON as an 'advanced' fallback.

medium_low.title: No cancel-round / sponsor-refund UI, and the deployed contract predates the refund method
medium_low.evidence: cancelRound(creator,roundId) and refundMatchingPoolContribution(funder,roundId) exist in the repo build but no UI exposes either (money-in via addMatchingPool has no exit). Worse, the DEPLOYED mainnet/testnet contract 0xe2fba2a7 has 35 methods and `refundMatchingPoolContribution` is absent (verified via getcontractstate) — the repo's audit-fixed build (NEW-H-8 per-funder ledger) was never deployed.
medium_low.fix: Redeploy the current build (or update via the contract's update()), then add 'Cancel round' (creator, pre-start, zero contributions) and 'Refund my matching' (visible when round.cancelled and the wallet funded the pool) to RoundAdminPanel.

medium_low.title: Global witness scope requested for createRound / addMatching / contribute
medium_low.evidence: globalSignerForCurrentWallet() (lines 32-36, same in useQuadraticRounds.ts:100-104) signs with scopes 'Global', letting any contract in the tx spend any of the user's assets — far beyond need, and pointless once the deposit-then-act fix lands (the credit model needs no nested witness at all).
medium_low.fix: Drop the custom signers (default CalledByEntry) after adding the deposit leg; if a nested transfer-from-user path is ever kept, use scopes 'CustomContracts' with allowedcontracts [QF contract, asset hash].

medium_low.title: Round form: free-text datetimes and hardcoded GAS asset
medium_low.evidence: startTime/endTime are plain NeoInput text fields relying on a placeholder format (lines 48-63) — easy to mistype, no picker, no min-date validation until the generic 'invalidRound' toast; onSubmit hardcodes asset: 'GAS' (line 81) though the contract and parse logic support NEO rounds.
medium_low.fix: Use <input type="datetime-local"> (or a NeoInput type extension), validate end > start > now inline under the fields, and add a GAS/NEO asset select that drives the existing decimals logic.

purpose: Tip and appreciate developers with crypto: developers self-register on-chain, anyone tips them GAS (optionally anonymously), developers withdraw their accrued tips.

journeys.name: Browse developer leaderboard
journeys.detail: totalDevelopers() + getDeveloper(1..N) fan-out (capped 500), sorted by lifetime tips with ranks; empty state has illustration plus a collapsible 4-step 'How it works' guide — strong first-run experience.

journeys.name: Register as developer
journeys.detail: registerDeveloper(wallet,name,role) under own witness, devId resolved from the DeveloperRegistered event, panel flips to registered view with claimable balance after refresh. Name/role length mirrors contract limits (64).

journeys.name: Send a tip
journeys.detail: Deposit-then-act with credit reuse (creditOf read skips the deposit when covered) and exact-amount deposits. Friction: the deposit transfer does NOT wait for the Credited confirmation, so the immediate tip() races the unconfirmed deposit — a first-time tipper's flow typically errors with 'GAS deposited as credit, tip again' and needs a second submit (which then succeeds from credit).

journeys.name: Withdraw accrued tips (developer)
journeys.detail: withdrawTips(devId) under the developer witness, waits TipsWithdrawn, amount surfaced from the event, button disabled with 'nothing to withdraw' label at zero balance.

journeys.name: Withdraw stranded tipper credit
journeys.detail: The contract exposes Withdraw(account) and the tipPrepaidNoTip copy promises the credit is 'reclaimable via withdraw', but no UI control or action calls it — a tipper whose step-2 permanently fails can only recover by tipping the same amount to someone.

journeys.name: View recent tips feed
journeys.detail: Tipped events → newest 25, anonymous tips correctly suppress the tipper, devId resolved to names. Depends on the shared events client (envelope bug under gov-merc) — currently degrades to an empty feed when the platform-API fallback is unavailable.

medium_low.title: Tip form collects a message and tipper name that are silently discarded
medium_low.evidence: Lines 41-42 render 'optional message' and 'tipper name' inputs, but useDevTippingWallet.sendTip names them _tipMessage/_tipperName and never uses them (lines 83-84) — the contract stores neither, and the recent-tips feed shows only a truncated address or 'Anonymous'. Users compose messages believing the developer will see them.
medium_low.fix: Remove the two inputs (the anonymous toggle already covers identity), or keep only the name field with explicit helper text 'not stored on-chain — shown to no one' — removing is more honest given there is no off-chain store.

medium_low.title: No UI to reclaim stranded tip credit despite the contract and error copy supporting it
medium_low.evidence: MiniAppTipJar exposes Withdraw(account) ('no credit' guarded, CreditWithdrawn event) and the tipPrepaidNoTip locale string tells users their GAS 'persists as reusable prepaid credit (reclaimable via withdraw)' — but neither useDevTippingWallet nor PlayArea wires a withdraw-credit action, so the money-out path the message promises does not exist in the app.
medium_low.fix: Add creditOf(wallet) to the refresh cycle and, when > 0, render a small 'Unused tip credit: X GAS — Withdraw' row in the Developer Zone card dispatching a new withdrawCredit action → chain.invoke('withdraw', [Hash160 walletHash], { waitForEvent: 'CreditWithdrawn' }) (mirror gov-merc's MercStakerPanel credit row).

medium_low.title: Registry fallback compares contract hex wallet to base58 address (dead branch)
medium_low.evidence: Lines 56-62: syncMyDeveloper's defensive lookup `stats.developers.get().find((dev) => dev.wallet === addr)` compares getDeveloper's Hash160 ('0x…' hex) with the base58 wallet address — never true, so the fallback never fires. The primary developerIdOf(addr) path masks it, but the dead code invites the same comparison bug to spread.
medium_low.fix: Compare script hashes: `dev.wallet && addressToScriptHash(dev.wallet) === addressToScriptHash(addr)` (or normalize dev.wallet to base58 in mapDeveloper, which would also let the UI show developer addresses).

medium_low.title: Register form clears inputs before the transaction outcome is known
medium_low.evidence: Lines 80-85: handleRegister calls onRegister(...) then immediately setName('')/setRole(''). If the registration fails (wallet reject, revert), the user's typed name/role are wiped — inconsistent with the tip form, which clears only on confirmed success (PlayArea.tsx:72-77).
medium_low.fix: Make onRegister async-aware: have PlayArea's handleRegisterDeveloper await dispatch and return the boolean (the action already returns devId>0), and clear the fields in DeveloperPanel only when it resolves true.

purpose: Lock NEO/GAS in escrow and release tranches to a beneficiary as the creator approves 1-12 milestones; creator can cancel and reclaim unapproved funds.

journeys.name: Create escrow (deposit + createEscrow)
journeys.detail: Form (1-12 milestone repeater, NEO/GAS toggle, live total) -> dispatch createEscrow -> deposit transfer with memo 'miniapp-milestone-escrow:fund' -> waitForDepositConfirmation poll -> createEscrow(creator,beneficiary,asset,total,amounts[],title,notes) with waitForEvent EscrowCreated -> refresh. Args match the ABI exactly (1-based milestone index mapping handled). Friction: no separate escrow-name field — title silently becomes the description or the beneficiary address.

journeys.name: Retry after deposit-succeeded/create-failed
journeys.detail: The depositPrepaidNoEscrow message tells the user to 'retry', but createEscrow() unconditionally deposits the FULL total again (no shortfall logic, and the contract exposes no creditOf getter to check). createEscrow consumes exactly one totalAmount of credit, so the first deposit is left as permanently stranded credit — the contract has no Withdraw method (confirmed absent from the ABI and all partial .cs files).

journeys.name: Approve milestone (creator)
journeys.detail: Approve button -> approveMilestone(creator, escrowId, idx+1) with waitForEvent MilestoneApproved -> refresh. Works, but the card never shows per-milestone amounts, so the creator approves 'the next milestone' without seeing how much it releases.

journeys.name: Claim milestone (beneficiary)
journeys.detail: Incoming ('For you') card -> claimMilestone(beneficiary, escrowId, idx+1) waits MilestoneClaimed -> refresh shows released/total. Disabled state has a tooltip ('No approved milestone to claim').

journeys.name: Cancel escrow / exit path
journeys.detail: cancelEscrow refunds remaining; contract guard (audit fix C-3) correctly refuses cancel while an approved milestone is unclaimed, so the beneficiary cannot be rugged. Friction: one-click irreversible cancel with no confirmation step.

journeys.name: First open without a connected wallet
journeys.detail: contractReady is derived purely from Boolean(address), so a disconnected user sees the 'Contract deployment pending / missing contract address' notice — the wrong message — and the connect-wallet branch with its Connect button (EscrowBody else-branch) is mathematically unreachable since contractReady === hasAddress.

medium_low.title: Disconnected-wallet state shows 'deployment pending' and the Connect button is unreachable
medium_low.evidence: contractReady = createDerived(() => Boolean(address.get())) (useMilestoneEscrow.ts:225). EscrowBody returns the deploymentPendingTitle notice when !contractReady, and the !hasAddress branch containing the connectWallet button requires contractReady && !hasAddress — impossible since both derive from the same address.
medium_low.fix: Derive contractReady from chain.contractAddress.get() (what the copy actually describes) and let the !hasAddress branch handle the disconnected case, restoring the Connect Wallet call-to-action.

medium_low.title: Cards never list per-milestone amounts; Approve/Claim act blind on 'the next' milestone
medium_low.evidence: renderDetails shows only total, released and 'done/count milestones'. nextApprovableIndex picks the milestone, but neither the index nor its amount (escrow.milestoneAmounts[idx] is available) is shown on the button or card.
medium_low.fix: Render a compact per-milestone row list (index, amount, approved/claimed pill) and label the action button 'Approve M2 — 1.5 GAS' using formatAmountFunc(escrow.assetSymbol, escrow.milestoneAmounts[idx]).

medium_low.title: One-click irreversible cancel without confirmation
medium_low.evidence: The Cancel button dispatches cancelEscrow immediately; cancellation permanently ends the escrow and refunds remaining funds — there is no confirm step or undo.
medium_low.fix: Add a two-step confirm (button flips to 'Confirm cancel — refunds X GAS' for 5s, or a small inline confirm row) before dispatching cancelEscrow.

medium_low.title: Hero 'milestone' checkpoints actually plot escrow completion counts
medium_low.evidence: progressPercent = completedCount/totalEscrows and checkpoints labelled M1..M5 are built from Math.min(totalEscrows||4,5) — escrow counts dressed up as milestones under a 'Milestones' label (MilestoneHero progress band).
medium_low.fix: Either relabel the band to 'Escrows completed' or compute real milestone progress (sum of claimed milestones / total milestones across active escrows).

medium_low.title: Hero 'Escrows' stat counts only created escrows, ignoring incoming ones
medium_low.evidence: totalEscrows = creatorEscrows.length feeds the first hero tile labelled with the generic escrowsTab key; a pure beneficiary with 5 incoming escrows sees '—'.
medium_low.fix: Use creatorEscrows.length + beneficiaryEscrows.length for the total tile, or relabel it with statCreated.

medium_low.title: No escrow-name input; unused locale keys; title falls back to the beneficiary address
medium_low.evidence: handleCreate sends name: description.trim() || beneficiary — an escrow with an empty description is titled by the raw N-address. Locale ships escrowName/escrowNamePlaceholder/notes keys (messages.ts:8-9,28-29) that no input uses.
medium_low.fix: Add the escrowName NeoInput (wired to the existing keys) and fall back to '#<id>' rather than the beneficiary address.

purpose: Two-party matched-stake relationship pact: both stake GAS; the breaker forfeits both stakes to the other party, honoring to expiry refunds both.

journeys.name: Create pact (party1 stakes)
journeys.detail: Form (partner address, stake/duration presets, title+terms with live counters) -> deposit GAS with memo 'miniapp-breakup:stake' -> createPact(party1,party2,stake,durationSeconds) waits PactCreated, id from event state[0]. Args match the ABI. Friction: the deposit's consuming call fires without waiting for block inclusion (race), and the form wipes itself even when the action failed.

journeys.name: Partner signs (party2 matches stake)
journeys.detail: signContract correctly reads the exact on-chain stake and would call signPact(pactId,party2) — but the Sign button never renders: ContractList compares the wallet N-address against getPact's party fields, which parseStackItem returns as 0x-hex script hashes (parseByteLike), so isParty is always false. Pacts can never become ACTIVE through this UI.

journeys.name: Break an active pact (forfeit)
journeys.detail: Same isParty=false bug hides the Break button for both parties; breakPact(pactId,breaker) is never reachable even though the composable implements it.

journeys.name: Cancel a pending pact (party1 reclaims stake)
journeys.detail: The contract explicitly supports party1 breaking a PENDING pact to cancel and reclaim (MiniAppBreakupPact.cs:174), but the UI gates Break on isParty && isActive — there is NO control on a pending card for the creator. A creator whose partner never signs has locked GAS with no UI exit, doubly dead because isParty is also always false.

journeys.name: Settle an honored, expired pact
journeys.detail: settleable = active && now >= endTime drives a permissionless Settle button (correctly offered even to non-parties); settlePact(pactId) waits PactSettled and refunds both. This is the only lifecycle action that works, because its gate does not depend on the broken party comparison.

journeys.name: Withdraw stranded stake credit
journeys.detail: The deployed contract exposes withdraw(account) + creditOf(who) (CreditWithdrawn event), but the app renders no credit balance and no withdraw control; the composable comment even claims 'no refund call and none is needed'. A user who rejects the second wallet prompt after the stake transfer has GAS stuck as credit with no visible exit — and the retry path deposits the full stake again (no creditOf check), compounding it.

medium_low.title: Deposit-then-act fires the consuming call without waiting for deposit inclusion
medium_low.evidence: createContract and signContract chain.invoke the GAS transfer (relay-only — ChainService.invoke returns at broadcast) then immediately invoke createPact/signPact; intra-block ordering is fee/hash-based so the consuming call can execute first and fault 'insufficient credit', surfacing the scary depositPrepaidNoContract error spuriously. Milestone-escrow and self-loan already wait (waitForDepositConfirmation / waitForEvent Credited).
medium_low.fix: Wait on the deposit before step 2: chain.invoke(transfer, ..., { waitForEvent: 'Credited' }) (the contract emits Credited from OnNEP17Payment) or call waitForDepositConfirmation(txid, { contractHash: GAS_HASH }) with the existing 4s fallback.

medium_low.title: Sign affordance not restricted to party2 — creator self-sign deposits a second stake then reverts
medium_low.evidence: Gate is isParty && isPending, and party1 is a party. SignPact asserts p.Party2 == party2 (MiniAppBreakupPact.cs:151), so once isParty is fixed, party1 tapping Sign would transfer a full matching stake and then revert — stranding it as credit (no withdraw UI, finding above).
medium_low.fix: Gate Sign on ownerMatchesAddress(contract.party2, address) && isPending && !contract.party2Signed; also guard in signContract() by comparing party2Hash against the pact's party2 before transferring.

medium_low.title: Party2 must stake against terms they cannot see, with no explanation
medium_low.evidence: Title/terms live only in the creator's device store (META_STORE_KEY); a partner's card shows 'Untitled pact' and no terms — they are asked to match a GAS stake with zero context and no hint that terms are device-local.
medium_low.fix: On cards without local meta, render an explainer line ('Title and terms are stored on the creator's device — verify them together before signing') via a new i18n key, and show stake/duration prominently as the only on-chain facts.

medium_low.title: Create form resets even when the action failed
medium_low.evidence: handleCreate awaits dispatch then unconditionally clears partner/stake/title/terms; notify.guard swallows errors, so a validation or chain failure wipes everything the user typed (milestone-escrow solved this by returning a success boolean from the action).
medium_low.fix: Make the createContract action return guardResult === true (as milestone-escrow's createEscrow does) and only reset the form on true.

medium_low.title: Creator's card shows themselves as 'Partner', rendered as a truncated hex hash
medium_low.evidence: partner = me === party1.toLowerCase() ? party2 : party1 always resolves to party1 (comparison never matches), so creators see their own script hash, truncated 0x form, under 'Partner'.
medium_low.fix: After switching to ownerMatchesAddress, convert the chosen counterparty hash to an N-address (scriptHashToAddress) before display.

medium_low.title: 'Ended' conflates settled (refunded) and cancelled
medium_low.evidence: STATUS_SETTLED and STATUS_CANCELLED both map to contractStatus 'ended'; the user cannot tell an honored, refunded pact from one cancelled before signing.
medium_low.fix: Map cancelled to its own display status with a distinct label/pill (locale already distinguishes contractSettled/contractBroken toasts; add a 'cancelled' status key).

purpose: M-of-N on-chain custody vault: create a vault from signer addresses + threshold, deposit NEO/GAS, propose spends, collect per-signer approvals; the contract releases funds at threshold (v2: any-signer cancel, unfunded auto-cancel notice).

journeys.name: Create vault
journeys.detail: Signer inputs + threshold select -> validateSignerSet -> createVault(creator,signers[],threshold) -> then the app reads lastVaultId() IMMEDIATELY after relay. invokeDirectly returns at broadcast (pre-inclusion), so the read sees the previous counter: first-ever creator gets 'Vault #0 created' and no receipt; otherwise the PREVIOUS (possibly someone else's) vault is loaded into activeVault and local history.

journeys.name: Create a vault with more than 3 signers
journeys.detail: SIGNER_SLOTS is hardcoded to 3 with no add-row control; the contract and validateSignerSet support up to 16 signers, so common 3-of-4 / 4-of-5 boards cannot be configured.

journeys.name: Deposit into vault
journeys.detail: NEP-17 transfer to the contract with vaultId as data, correctly targeting the token contract (base-unit math is float-free). But refreshVault runs immediately after relay, so the success toast appears while balances are still stale; the user must reload the vault later to see the deposit.

journeys.name: Propose spend request
journeys.detail: createRequest args match the ABI and there is a good pre-flight BigInt balance guard, but the new id is read from lastRequestId() pre-inclusion — same staleness as createVault: wrong/0 request id in toast, wrong request hydrated into state and history.

journeys.name: Co-signer loads request by id and approves
journeys.detail: loadRequest hydrates the request AND its parent vault (so N/threshold renders correctly) — the cold co-signer entry path is well designed. approve(reqId,signer) is correct, but the post-approve refreshRequest is pre-inclusion, so approvalCount/status don't move and an executed request still shows the generic 'approved' toast until a manual reload; hasApproved() exists in the API but is never used to disable the button for signers who already approved.

journeys.name: Cancel pending request (v2 any-signer)
journeys.detail: Cancel affordance is correctly NOT gated to the creator; cancel(reqId,caller) matches the v2 contract (caller witness + vault-signer check on-chain).

journeys.name: Underfunded auto-cancel explanation (v2)
journeys.detail: RequestUnfunded(reqId, required, available) is resolved via listEvents and rendered both as a toast and an inline notice with amounts — good design; but because the post-approve read-back is stale, the unfunded explanation usually only appears after a later manual reload.

medium_low.title: Signer slots hardcoded to 3 — vaults with 4-16 signers cannot be created
medium_low.evidence: const SIGNER_SLOTS = 3 seeds a fixed 3-input grid with no add/remove controls, while MAX_SIGNERS = 16 (utils/vault.ts:35) and the contract accepts up to 16; the multisigTooManySigners validation message is unreachable.
medium_low.fix: Make the signer list dynamic: '+ Add signer' button (cap 16) and per-row remove (floor 2), mirroring milestone-escrow's milestone repeater pattern.

medium_low.title: Request id — the thing co-signers need — is only shown in a transient toast
medium_low.evidence: The vault gets a persistent receipt row (#id + 'share with signers' copy) but the active request details panel shows status/amount/signers/to with NO id, and history labels are 'amount asset' only (main.tsx:144-150). If the proposer misses the toast there is no way to read the id back out of the UI.
medium_low.fix: Add the request id (#N) with a copy button to the multisig-request-details block and prefix history request labels with '#id'.

medium_low.title: Vault signer addresses never displayed; Approve not gated by hasApproved or signer membership
medium_low.evidence: The aside shows only signer COUNT and threshold even though activeVault.signers is loaded; api.hasApproved exists (api.ts:187-193) but is never called, so a signer who already approved — or a non-signer — gets an enabled Approve button that reverts on-chain with a raw assert message.
medium_low.fix: List shortened signer addresses in the signer panel (highlight the connected wallet); on request load, call hasApproved(reqId, connectedAddress) and membership-check against activeVault.signers to disable Approve with an explanatory hint.

medium_low.title: Dates formatted with a hardcoded 'en' locale
medium_low.evidence: formatDate uses toLocaleDateString('en')/toLocaleTimeString('en', ...) — Chinese users see English-formatted dates in the activity panel despite full 121-key en/zh message parity.
medium_low.fix: Resolve the locale from the i18n layer (or pass undefined to use the runtime locale) instead of the 'en' literal.

medium_low.title: No connect-wallet empty state — first action silently triggers ensureWallet
medium_low.evidence: connectedAddress is tracked in state but never rendered; unlike milestone-escrow/self-loan there is no notice or connect prompt before the user fills a whole form and hits Create.
medium_low.fix: Show a slim connected-as row (shortened address) in the hero, with a connect prompt when empty, reusing the existing connectedAddress observable.

purpose: Lock whole-NEO collateral to borrow GAS upfront (tiered 20/30/40% LTV against an owner-set NEO price) from an owner-funded pool; repay GAS to release the NEO.

journeys.name: Borrow (deposit NEO -> borrow)
journeys.detail: Integer-NEO validation -> reads collateralCreditOf and tops up only the SHORTFALL (consent guard blocks when residual credit exceeds the typed amount) -> NEO transfer with memo 'selfloan:collateral' waiting CollateralCredited -> borrow(borrower,tier) waiting LoanTaken -> full reload. Exemplary deposit-then-act implementation; the friction is the on-screen Estimated Borrow being wrong by the NEO price factor (below) and no pool-liquidity preflight.

journeys.name: Borrow while a loan is already active
journeys.detail: The Borrow card stays fully enabled with an active loan; the contract asserts 'loan already active' (MiniAppSelfLoan.cs:186) only in step 2 — AFTER the NEO deposit landed — so a predictable failure routes the user's NEO into the credit-reclaim detour instead of being blocked up front.

journeys.name: Add collateral
journeys.detail: Same shortfall-aware deposit then addCollateral(borrower) waiting CollateralAdded; contract requires an active loan, and the card only renders when hasLoan.

journeys.name: Repay (partial and full)
journeys.detail: Strict decimal regex, client-side cap at outstanding debt (repayExceedsDebt), rejects repay with no active loan (avoids stranding GAS as repay credit), credit-aware top-up, repay(borrower) waits Repaid; full repayment releases NEO in the same call and the reload reflects it.

journeys.name: Reclaim stranded credits (NEO collateral / GAS repay)
journeys.detail: collateralCreditOf/repayCreditOf are polled on every load; non-zero credit surfaces dedicated reclaim cards calling withdraw/withdrawRepayCredit with event waits. This is the exit-path gold standard the other custody apps in this cluster should copy.

journeys.name: Understand loan terms before borrowing (price, pool)
journeys.detail: The debt is sized by the owner-set neoPrice and disbursed from pool(), but neither is shown anywhere; the Estimated Borrow preview ignores the price entirely, and pool exhaustion is only discovered as a post-deposit revert.

medium_low.title: Borrow form enabled during an active loan — predictable revert after the NEO deposit lands
medium_low.evidence: canBorrow is only !localCollateralAmt || isBorrowing; with loan.active the deposit tx succeeds, then borrow asserts 'loan already active', dumping the NEO into collateralCredit and forcing the user through the reclaim card for a failure the UI could have prevented.
medium_low.fix: When hasLoan, disable the Borrow button with an inline hint pointing at the Add Collateral card ('One loan per address — add collateral or repay first'); also guard in takeLoan() before the transfer.

medium_low.title: Owner-set NEO price and pool liquidity invisible pre-borrow
medium_low.evidence: neoPrice is loaded but only used for ratio math; pool() is in the ABI yet never read. Users cannot see the rate that sizes their debt ('1 NEO = X GAS') and pool exhaustion surfaces only as the post-deposit 'insufficient pool liquidity' assert (MiniAppSelfLoan.cs:203) -> credit-held detour.
medium_low.fix: Read pool() in loadAll; render '1 NEO = {price} GAS' and 'Pool available: {pool} GAS' in the Borrow card, and pre-flight block borrowing when expected net disbursement > pool.

medium_low.title: Health gauge shows a 'Liquidation' marker while the app promises no liquidations
medium_low.evidence: Gauge endpoints read 'Liquidation' / 'Safe' (locale key liquidation, messages.ts:63) but the ABI has no liquidate method and the locale itself says 'Your collateral is never at risk - no forced liquidations regardless of market conditions' (messages.ts:107) — contradictory risk signaling.
medium_low.fix: Replace the 'Liquidation' endpoint label with a neutral 'Under-collateralized' (new key) or drop the endpoints and keep the Safe/Caution/Danger status label only.

medium_low.title: Inputs cleared even when the action failed; no repay-max quick fill
medium_low.evidence: handleBorrow/handleRepay/handleAddCollateral reset their local input after dispatch unconditionally — notify.guard swallows failures so a typo'd retry must be retyped; repaying the exact outstanding debt requires manually copying the Borrowed figure.
medium_low.fix: Have the actions return the guard result and only clear on success; add a 'Max' chip on the repay input that fills the outstanding debt (borrowedDisplay).

medium_low.title: Hero badge is a hardcoded '$' glyph
medium_low.evidence: {'$'} — a raw dollar character (USD connotation for a NEO/GAS product) where sibling apps use SVG/CategoryIcon badges.
medium_low.fix: Swap in a small inline SVG (vault/coin motif) or CategoryIcon name="finance" consistent with the cluster's 40px circular badge pattern.

purpose: Create recurring GAS/NEO payment streams (payroll, subscriptions, allowances) that lock on-chain, vest over time, and let beneficiaries claim while creators can cancel.

journeys.name: create GAS stream
journeys.detail: Form -> createStream action -> deposit NEP-17 transfer with memo 'miniapp-neo-pay:fund' -> createStream(creator,beneficiary,asset,total,rate,intervalSeconds,title,notes). Verified against the deployed MiniAppNeoPay ABI on mainnet 0xfd4dcc34... and testnet 0x27a81e6d... (all method names+arity match; waitForEvent StreamCreated confirms; refreshStreams re-reads getUserStreams+getStreamDetails so the new stream appears without reload). Friction: the deposit is broadcast and createStream fires immediately with NO deposit-confirmation wait, so intra-block ordering can fault the create; and a failed create wipes the whole form.

journeys.name: create NEO stream
journeys.detail: NEO handled as indivisible integer (no float math). But deriveSchedule silently collapses sub-1-NEO/day totals into a single cliff release at the end of the term (e.g. '5 NEO over 30 days' pays nothing until day 30) with zero preview or warning; the rateRoundsToZero/releasePerDay locale keys exist but are unused in this PlayArea.

journeys.name: claim vested funds (beneficiary)
journeys.detail: Incoming list shows on-chain 'claimable' (verified the deployed getStreamDetails Map includes claimable/releasedAmount/status); claimStream(beneficiary,id) actor-first witness matches ABI; waitForEvent StreamClaimed then refresh updates progress bar and claimable without reload.

journeys.name: cancel stream / reclaim unvested funds (creator)
journeys.detail: cancelStream(creator,id) matches ABI, waitForEvent StreamCancelled, list refreshes, status badge flips to cancelled; user exit path exists.

journeys.name: recover a stranded deposit credit
journeys.detail: If the deposit lands but createStream fails, the toast tells the user to 'submit again to reuse it without depositing twice' — but handleCreateVault unconditionally re-runs the deposit leg on every submit, so a retry deposits a second time and strands one full credit. The deployed contract (both networks, ABI verified) has NO withdraw or credit-read method, so that credit is permanently locked unless a stream of the exact amount is later created.

medium_low.title: Failed create wipes all five form fields
medium_low.evidence: handleCreateStream (lines 147-155) clears recipient/amount/duration/token/notes after `await dispatch(...)` unconditionally, and the createStream action wraps the call in notify.guard which swallows errors and resolves normally (main.tsx:47-59; NotificationService.ts:148-155 returns undefined on failure). A validation or chain failure both toasts an error AND erases what the user typed.
medium_low.fix: Switch the action to notify.guardResult and surface success (return the result from the action or set a lastCreateOk observable); in PlayArea only reset the fields when the create actually succeeded.

medium_low.title: Stream cards show the interval (always '1d') instead of the stream duration
medium_low.evidence: getDurationDays (lines 180-181) returns stream.duration ?? stream.intervalDays; on-chain items never have duration and GAS streams always have intervalDays=1 (daily linear release from deriveSchedule), so a 30-day, 30-GAS stream renders '1d' in both lists (lines 457-461, 563-567).
medium_low.fix: Compute total duration = ceil(totalAmount / rateAmount) * intervalDays in parseStreamDetails and bind that to the card; keep intervalDays for a separate 'release every N d' detail.

medium_low.title: No schedule preview; NEO sub-1/day totals silently become a single end-of-term cliff
medium_low.evidence: Lines 33-41: when truncated NEO/day < 1, rate=total and intervalDays=duration — the whole amount releases only at the horizon. The create form (PlayArea.tsx:325-390) shows no derived 'release per day' line, and the existing releasePerDay/releasePerDayValue/rateRoundsToZero keys (locale/messages.ts:165-172) are only used by the shared example app, not here.
medium_low.fix: Render a live schedule preview under the form: 'X GAS/day for N days', or for the NEO cliff case the explicit notice 'releases all N NEO at day D' reusing the existing locale keys.

medium_low.title: Recipient/sender rendered as little-endian script-hash hex (or mojibake), not an N3 address
medium_low.evidence: getStreamDetails returns creator/beneficiary as raw UInt160 ByteStrings (verified live on testnet stream #1); shared parseByteLike (apps/shared/utils/neo.ts:43-49) converts them to '0x<le-hex>' — or decoded text when the 20 bytes happen to be printable — so cards show 'To: 0x561cc0...46310c' (formatAddress at PlayArea.tsx:166-167) instead of the address the creator entered. No scriptHashToAddress helper exists anywhere in apps/shared.
medium_low.fix: Add scriptHashToAddress (base58check encode of 0x35+hash+checksum; sha256 shim already imported in shared/utils/neo.ts) and convert creator/beneficiary in parseStreamDetails before display.

medium_low.title: Status badges bypass i18n — zh users see raw English 'active/completed/cancelled'
medium_low.evidence: Lines 435-439 and 541-544 render {stream.status ?? t("active")} — when status exists (always, from normalizeStatus) the raw lowercase English string is printed, despite statusActive/statusCompleted/statusCancelled existing in locale/messages.ts:114-118.
medium_low.fix: Map status to its locale key: t(`status${status[0].toUpperCase()}${status.slice(1)}`).

medium_low.title: Long NEO streams fail with a misnamed 'Interval out of range' error
medium_low.evidence: For NEO cliffs deriveSchedule sets intervalDays=duration (deriveSchedule.ts:40), so a duration over 365 days trips the interval bound check (useNeoPayApp.ts:347-350) and the user is told the 'interval' — a field they never edited — is out of range.
medium_low.fix: Validate the duration input directly in the action with a durationInvalid message; keep the interval check as an internal assertion.

purpose: Free GAS sponsorship for new low-balance users (request up to 0.1 GAS/day), plus donate-to-pool and send-GAS 'pay it forward' transfers.

journeys.name: check eligibility / view fuel tank
journeys.detail: Tank, balance, quota and eligibility all come from the platform HTTP API. VITE_PLATFORM_API is absent from .env/.env.example (PLATFORM_API='' confirmed in the built bundle), and the live edge endpoint (edge.meshmini.app/api/gas-sponsor/eligibility) still returns 503 runtime_temporarily_degraded ('only health and info probes are restored') despite the broader oracle restoration. checkEligibility silently falls back to gas_balance '0' on both conditions, so EVERY wallet — including funded ones — sees an empty tank, 'Needs Fuel', 'Eligible', with no service notice.

journeys.name: request sponsored GAS
