medium_low.evidence: Live /neodid/runtime is failing (503/400 verified), so resolved documents carry versionId 'unversioned' and empty verificationMethod (morpheus-neodid.ts:252,262-271); the UI shows 'unversioned' with no hint that the passport lacks the verifier key a relying party would need.
medium_low.fix: When resolution.versionId === 'unversioned', show a small warning chip on the result head ('Runtime attestation metadata unavailable — passport lacks TEE verification key') so users know the credential is degraded.

medium_low.title: Unknown resolver errors surface raw upstream text
medium_low.evidence: translateKnownError falls through to `return key`, so non-whitelisted upstream messages (e.g. mainnet's current 'worker signer drift: no usable worker signer configured') would be shown verbatim in the alert and status tile.
medium_low.fix: Default the fallthrough to t('resolverFailed') and log the raw message to console.warn instead of rendering it.

medium_low.title: Stat tiles seed with 'N/A' placeholders
medium_low.evidence: lastDigest/documentId/documentVersion initialize to ctx.t('notAvailable') = 'N/A', which renders error-like placeholders in the header Digest tile before first use.
medium_low.fix: Seed with '—' (em-dash) via a digestPlaceholder key, matching the oracle-seal-console precedent.

purpose: Operator surface for AA guardian policy, recovery ticket flow, timelock review, and final recovery execution (per manifest description).

journeys.name: query guardian state (verifier + backup owner)
journeys.detail: queryGuardianState derives the AA account-id (same deriveAAAccountIdHash convention AA Account Lab uses — address-as-seed, verified against useAAAccountLab.ts) and reads getVerifier/getBackupOwner on AA core 0x0268a387… — both methods confirmed present on the deployed UnifiedSmartWalletV3 via mainnet RPC. Zero-hash normalized to null, snapshot cached in ctx.os.storage, success/error toasts wired.

journeys.name: review threshold / timelock policy
journeys.detail: threshold and timelock are displayed in the hero stats, sidebar, and state grid but NO code path ever populates them — the query writes only account_id/verifier_hash/backup_owner/checked_at, and the 'cached extras from a prior recovery flow' the merge comment relies on are written by nothing. They are permanently 'N/A'.

journeys.name: prepare, open, copy, share recovery preview/credential links
journeys.detail: All six link actions build URLs on https://neo-recovery.app/… — the domain has NO DNS records (verified dig: empty). Open = browser error page; Copy/Share confidently hands guardians a dead link for an account-recovery emergency.

journeys.name: open Identity / AA workspaces
journeys.detail: openIdentityWorkspace → https://neo-identity.app/workspace, openAaWorkspace → https://neo-aa.app/workspace — neither domain resolves (verified), while the app's own README documents the real, live surfaces (https://neo-abstract-account.vercel.app/identity and /app both return 200).

journeys.name: recovery ticket flow and final recovery execution
journeys.detail: Promised in the manifest description and README ('NeoDID recovery tickets… final recovery execution') but there is no ticket creation, no timelock countdown, no execute/cancel action, and the bundled SocialRecoveryVerifier contract (0x198b3a9c…, declared in neo-manifest.json) is never read or invoked.

journeys.name: open recovery docs
journeys.detail: https://docs.neo.org/recovery-guardian 301-redirects to the generic docs index (verified) — not recovery documentation; the in-app docs panel additionally renders base-message boilerplate ('Follow the on-screen instructions').

medium_low.title: Unset verifier masked by the network constant — operator believes recovery is configured when it isn't
medium_low.evidence: verifier_hash: verifier ?? (socialRecoveryVerifier || null) — when getVerifier returns zero/empty (account has NO verifier bound), the UI shows the network's SocialRecoveryVerifier address as if it were the account's live binding, in a security-critical recovery console.
medium_low.fix: Show the chain value only: verifier ?? null → render 'Not configured' for null; if you want to suggest the canonical verifier, render it separately as a labeled hint ('Network default verifier: 0x198b…') never in the Verifier state field.

medium_low.title: Verifier Hash Override collects input that only feeds the dead URL
medium_low.evidence: verifierHashOverride is validated and labeled 'Optional Hash160 override for diagnostics', but its only consumer is the ?verifier= param of the unresolvable neo-recovery.app URLs — it diagnoses nothing in-app.
medium_low.fix: Make the override actually drive a diagnostic: when set, read getVerifier-adjacent state against the override (or compare it to the bound verifier and badge match/mismatch); otherwise remove the field.

medium_low.title: Docs panel renders generic base-message boilerplate
medium_low.evidence: docs entries reference docSubtitle/docDescription/step2 which the app's locale never defines, so base-messages fillers render ('Documentation', 'Follow the on-screen instructions') — useless for a recovery operator; openRecoveryDocs additionally 301s to the generic docs.neo.org index.
medium_low.fix: Author real doc keys in locale/messages.ts (recovery preflight steps, what verifier/backup-owner mean, link to the AA workspace) and point openRecoveryDocs at an existing page (e.g. neo-abstract-account.vercel.app/docs).

medium_low.title: State cards and stats show 'N/A' instead of design-system em-dash
medium_low.evidence: renderedPayload and payloadField fall back to ctx.t('notAvailable') = 'N/A' across the six state cards, header stat tiles, and sidebar — pre-query the whole console reads like an error wall.
medium_low.fix: Use '—' for unpopulated payload fields and an explicit emptiness message for renderedPayload (the empty-state card already exists; gate the pill values on hasPayload).

purpose: User-facing TrustAnchor staking: stake NEO, redeem NEO, and claim GAS rewards routed through 21 admin-managed AA voting agents.

journeys.name: stake NEO
journeys.detail: PlayArea amount input (whole-NEO regex validated) -> dispatch stakeNeo -> useTrustAnchor.stakeNeo builds NEP-17 NEO transfer to PlatformAnchor 0x02beeef6... with memo 'stake:miniapp-trustanchor' -> contract OnNEP17Payment credits then StakeFromCredit auto-stakes -> waitForEvent AnchorStakeChanged (30s) -> loadAll refreshes stake/stats. Verified against PlatformAnchor.Staking.cs OnNEP17Payment string-prefix memo handling. Clean feedback: status strip, txid, local history.

journeys.name: redeem NEO
journeys.detail: withdrawNeo -> contract withdraw(appId,user,amount) transfers NEO directly back from the contract balance (TransferStakedNeoBackToUser), no pause gate on exit, event-wait + refresh. ABI args match manifest exactly.

journeys.name: claim GAS rewards
journeys.detail: Wiring is correct (claimRewards(appId,user) + AnchorRewardsClaimed wait), but on BOTH mainnet and testnet rewardReserve=0 and rewardPerNeo=0 (verified via getAnchorStats RPC), and ClaimRewards asserts 'no rewards' -> every claim reverts. No surface in the whole suite ever calls harvestRewards/fundRewards, so the app's headline reward promise cannot complete end-to-end today. Claim button is also never disabled when pendingRewards=0.

journeys.name: recover NEO deposit credit
journeys.detail: The UI prominently displays 'Claimable NEO' from getCredit(user,'NEO') (stat chip), but no action calls withdrawCredit. A user whose NEO landed as credit (bare deposit without the stake memo from an external wallet) sees a claimable balance with no button to claim it; withdraw() only debits stake ('insufficient stake' otherwise).

journeys.name: refresh status
journeys.detail: refreshAnchor -> loadAll (4 parallel reads), status set to 'Status refreshed', recorded in local history.

medium_low.title: Reward/NEO metric shows the raw 1e16-scaled accumulator
medium_low.evidence: rps: String(asNumber(asMapValue(result,'rewardPerNeo'))) is passed unscaled to rewardPerNeoDisplay (main.tsx:86-89). The contract value is GAS-datoshi * REWARD_SCALE(1e8) per NEO (PlatformAnchor.Internal.cs DistributeRewards), i.e. GAS/NEO x 1e16. One distributed GAS per NEO would render as '10,000,000,000,000,000.00'.
medium_low.fix: Divide by REWARD_SCALE * GAS_MULTIPLIER (1e16) before display: formatNum(rawRps / 1e16) and label it 'GAS per NEO (lifetime)'.

medium_low.title: agentCount fallback masks a genuine on-chain 0 as 21
medium_low.evidence: return Number.isFinite(count) && count > 0 ? count : agentAccounts.length — an on-chain count of 0 falls back to the static 21-entry roster. ProfitAnchor fixed exactly this ('a genuine on-chain 0 must render as 0', profitanchor/src/main.tsx:73-79); trustanchor kept the masking variant. Currently latent (mainnet/testnet both report 21) but lies the moment a network has an unregistered anchor.
medium_low.fix: Copy the profitanchor logic: only fall back while stats is null; render the real agentCount (including 0) once stats load.

medium_low.title: No shared in-flight lock across PlayArea and the manifest operation panel
medium_low.evidence: runAnchorAction has no submitting guard; the busy state lives only in PlayArea local useState. The host renders the manifest operations panel (src/manifest.ts operations stakeNeo/withdrawNeo/claimRewards) alongside PlayArea, so the same stake can be double-submitted from the two surfaces. ProfitAnchor added a shared `submitting` observable for exactly this (profitanchor/src/main.tsx:97-101).
medium_low.fix: Port profitanchor's shared `submitting` observable lock into runAnchorAction (early-return if already submitting; set in finally) and expose it to PlayArea.

medium_low.title: Claim button enabled with zero pending rewards
medium_low.evidence: Claim GAS button is only gated on isBusy. With pendingRewards=0 the contract asserts 'no rewards' (PlatformAnchor.Staking.cs:85) and the user gets a raw assert failure from the wallet test-invoke.
medium_low.fix: Disable the claim button when num('pendingRewards') <= 0 and show a tooltip/help line 'No GAS accrued yet'.

medium_low.title: No wallet NEO balance or Max helper on the amount field
medium_low.evidence: The single amount input serves both stake and redeem with no display of the wallet NEO balance (for stake) or current stake (Max for redeem); users guess and learn limits only from on-chain assert errors ('insufficient stake').
medium_low.fix: Show wallet NEO balance next to the field and add a Max chip that fills the wallet balance for stake / myStake for redeem.

medium_low.title: Agent roster is a hardcoded static file, not on-chain reads
medium_low.evidence: The 'How routing is protected' panel lists 21 static addresses/candidates compiled into the bundle; getAgent/getAgentCandidate/getAgentAccount (all safe ABI methods) are never read, so an admin candidate update or account rotation never reflects here.
medium_low.fix: Hydrate the expandable agent list from getAgent(appId, i) for i in 1..getAgentCount on first expand (lazy), falling back to the static roster on read failure.

medium_low.title: Four stat chips in a 3-column grid leave an orphan row
medium_low.evidence: .anchor-stat-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); } renders the 4 chips (rewards/tracked/reserve/claimable NEO) as 3 + 1 lonely chip on all widths including 560px.
medium_low.fix: Use repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)) (2x2) at all sizes, or repeat(4,...) above 860px collapsing to 2x2.

medium_low.title: Hook validation errors are English-only
medium_low.evidence: throw new Error('NEO is indivisible -- enter a positive whole number.') and siblings (lines 76, 85, 96, 110) surface verbatim in the status strip / notify.error for zh users; the hook receives `t` in its options but never uses it.
medium_low.fix: Thread the already-passed t() into the normalize* helpers and throw t('invalidAmount') / t('invalidAgentId') / t('invalidCandidateKey').

purpose: Operator-only console for TrustAnchor manual AA-agent routing: move NEO between the 21 agents, update an agent's council candidate, and sync the vote.

journeys.name: move NEO between agents
journeys.detail: Form -> transferAgentNeo dispatch -> chain.invoke('transferAgentNeo', appId/from/to/amount) signed only by the operator wallet. The contract requires HasAgentExecutionWitness(fromAgent): CheckWitness of the AA agent account OR a call routed through the AbstractAccount contract (PlatformAnchor.Internal.cs:156-167). The hook passes no extra signers and no AA route, so the on-chain assert 'from agent AA witness required' fails for a plain wallet invoke. The static roster even contains each agent's verificationScript, but it is never used.

journeys.name: update candidate key
journeys.detail: setAgentCandidate needs only ValidateAppAuthority (platform/app admin witness) + ValidateAgent; agentId 1-21 and 33-byte pubkey are client-validated; on-chain agents exist (agentCount=21 verified on both networks). Works for the real admin; reverts 'unauthorized' for anyone else.

journeys.name: sync agent vote
journeys.detail: voteAgent(appId, agentId) requires the agent AA witness (Agents.cs:96 HasAgentExecutionWitness then NEO.Vote(agentAccount,...)). Same gap as move: plain operator-wallet invoke cannot satisfy it. UI nicety: vote field pre-seeds from live selectedAgentId without clobbering manual edits (good).

journeys.name: fund/harvest GAS rewards for stakers
journeys.detail: harvestRewards/fundRewards exist in the ABI (admin-gated) and are the ONLY way the user apps' 'claim GAS' promise can ever pay out, but no action, form, or doc in this console exposes them. rewardReserve is 0 on mainnet and testnet.

journeys.name: register/rotate agent accounts
journeys.detail: registerAgent/registerAgents/setAgentAccount are not exposed. Registration was clearly done out-of-band (21 on-chain), but the contract's own security design comments (Agents.cs:64-70) assume operators rotate compromised agent accounts one-by-one — impossible from this console.

journeys.name: non-admin opens the console
journeys.detail: App is not featured but is openable; all controls render enabled. There is no admin()/getAppAdmin read or role banner, so a non-admin fills a form, hits submit, and gets a raw 'unauthorized' assert from wallet test-invoke via the notify.guard toast.

medium_low.title: No admin-role detection — non-admins get a fully armed console and raw 'unauthorized' errors
medium_low.evidence: The console never reads admin() or getAppAdmin('miniapp-trustanchor') (both safe ABI methods) to compare with chain.address; every card is enabled for any visitor and failure is the contract assert string surfaced by notify.guard.
medium_low.fix: On load, read getAppAdmin + admin(), compare with the connected address, and render a read-only state with an 'Operator wallet required (NXxx...)' banner when they don't match.

medium_low.title: Agent directory shows the static compile-time roster, not on-chain agents
medium_low.evidence: Imports TRUSTANCHOR_AGENT_ACCOUNTS from the sibling app's data file and renders it verbatim (PlayArea.tsx:241-254). An admin console must show ground truth: after setAgentCandidate or an account rotation the directory silently keeps stale addresses/candidates, and candidate updates can't be visually confirmed.
medium_low.fix: Replace with reads of getAgent(appId, i) for 1..getAgentCount (returns Map with account/candidate/active), refreshed after each successful action via the existing loadAll hook.

medium_low.title: Agent account rotation (setAgentAccount) has no UI
medium_low.evidence: PlatformAnchor.Agents.cs:64-79 deliberately ships single-agent rotation as the incident-response path ('off-chain monitors will catch on the first abnormal rotation'), but the operator console offers no way to execute it — the documented compromise-recovery runbook is unreachable.
medium_low.fix: Add a guarded 'Rotate agent account' card (agentId, new account, verification script hash, double-confirm dialog) calling setAgentAccount.

medium_low.title: Hardcoded English kicker and unformatted reserve figure
medium_low.evidence: TrustAnchor Admin bypasses t(); reserveDisplay = `${stats?.rewardReserve ?? 0} GAS` (line 22) is unformatted (can print long float). Hook-thrown validation errors ('Agent id must be an integer from 1 to 21.') are English-only in toasts.
medium_low.fix: Move the kicker to messages.ts (en/zh), wrap reserve with formatNumber(x,2), and localize hook errors via the t already passed into useTrustAnchor.

medium_low.title: Cross-app source import breaks the dependency-free app convention
medium_low.evidence: import { useTrustAnchor } from '../../trustanchor/src/hooks/useTrustAnchor' (plus the data file and the type import in PlayArea.tsx:5) couples the admin bundle to a sibling app's internals; per platform rules apps share only via apps/shared.
medium_low.fix: Lift useAnchor (parameterized by appId) and the roster into apps/shared (e.g. shared/composables/useAnchorStaking.ts) and consume it from all four anchor apps — also removes the trust/profit hook duplication.

purpose: User-facing ProfitAnchor staking: stake NEO, redeem NEO, claim GAS rewards (profit-mode twin of TrustAnchor on the same PlatformAnchor contract).

journeys.name: stake NEO
journeys.detail: Same correct memo-transfer wiring as trustanchor ('stake:miniapp-profitanchor', AnchorStakeChanged wait 30s, full refresh) and the best preflight UX of the cluster: amount plan line, route check, claim-readiness checklist, and the literal stake memo shown before signing. On-chain: mode=2 registered, 21 agents, contract HALT verified.

journeys.name: redeem NEO
journeys.detail: withdraw(appId,user,amount) direct NEO return; client-validated whole NEO; shared submitting lock prevents cross-panel double-submission (main.tsx:97-101).

journeys.name: claim GAS rewards
journeys.detail: Wiring correct; preflight even communicates 'nothing to claim' state. But rewardReserve=0 on mainnet (RPC-verified) and no surface in the suite funds it, so the journey cannot complete; the claim button itself is not disabled at 0 and would surface the 'no rewards' assert.

journeys.name: recover NEO deposit credit
journeys.detail: useProfitAnchor.loadPendingWithdraw reads getCredit(user,'NEO') and main.tsx exposes pendingWithdraw in state, but PlayArea never renders it and no action calls withdrawCredit — credit from a bare NEO deposit is both invisible and unrecoverable here (worse than trustanchor, which at least displays it).

journeys.name: refresh status
journeys.detail: Icon refresh button with aria-label/title, shared lock, status strip update.

medium_low.title: NEO credit loaded but never displayed and no withdrawCredit exit
medium_low.evidence: loadPendingWithdraw populates pendingWithdraw from getCredit(user,'NEO'); main.tsx:184 exposes it in state, but PlayArea.tsx renders only stake/pending/reserve metrics (lines 107-123) and registers no withdrawCredit action. A user whose deposit fell through to credit-only has funds with zero visibility and zero exit.
medium_low.fix: Add a conditional fourth metric 'Deposited NEO (unstaked)' when pendingWithdraw>0 plus a 'Recover' button invoking withdrawCredit(user,'NEO',amount).

medium_low.title: Zero stake/rewards render as em-dash after load, ambiguous with loading
medium_low.evidence: value: myStake > 0 ? myStakeDisplay : placeholder — a wallet-connected user with a genuine 0 NEO stake permanently sees '—' instead of '0 NEO', indistinguishable from data-not-loaded; reserve correctly distinguishes via hasReserve=Boolean(stats).
medium_low.fix: Gate on data-loaded like reserve does: show '—' only while stats/address are null, then render the real formatted 0.

medium_low.title: Claim button not gated on pendingRewards > 0
medium_low.evidence: The claim action button is only disabled on isBusy even though the same component already computes claimReady (line 83) for the preflight checklist; clicking with 0 rewards surfaces the contract 'no rewards' assert.
medium_low.fix: Add disabled={isBusy || !claimReady} to the claim button (the preflight row already explains why).

medium_low.title: Hardcoded English aria-label on the workspace section
medium_low.evidence: aria-label="ProfitAnchor staking workspace" bypasses t() while trustanchor uses t('stakingWorkspaceLabel') for the same element; hook validation errors (useProfitAnchor.ts:68,76) are also English-only.
medium_low.fix: Add a stakingWorkspaceLabel key (en/zh) and use t(); localize hook errors through the t option already passed in.

medium_low.title: No wallet balance / Max helper on the shared amount field
medium_low.evidence: Same gap as trustanchor: one amount field drives both stake and redeem with no wallet-NEO or staked-NEO context; over-withdraw is only caught by the on-chain 'insufficient stake' assert.
medium_low.fix: Show wallet NEO + my stake beside the field with tap-to-fill Max chips per action.

medium_low.title: Duplicated 400-line hook identical to useTrustAnchor
medium_low.evidence: Byte-for-byte clone of useTrustAnchor except APP_ID; bug fixes have already diverged once (agentCount masking fixed here, not in trustanchor), proving the duplication is actively rotting.
medium_low.fix: Extract a shared useAnchorStaking(appId) into apps/shared and parameterize both apps (and both admin consoles).

purpose: Operator-only console for ProfitAnchor manual AA-agent routing: move NEO between the 21 agents, update candidate keys, and sync the agent vote.

journeys.name: move NEO between agents
journeys.detail: Identical wiring to trustanchor-admin: plain operator-wallet invoke of transferAgentNeo cannot satisfy HasAgentExecutionWitness(fromAgent) (PlatformAnchor.Internal.cs:156-167); no signers/AA route is attached (useProfitAnchor.ts:286-314).

journeys.name: update candidate key
journeys.detail: Admin-witness-only on-chain path; client validates agentId 1-21 + compressed pubkey; notify.guard toasts success/error. Works for the genuine app admin.

journeys.name: sync agent vote
journeys.detail: voteAgent requires the agent AA witness; not supplied. Nice touch retained: vote field pre-seeds from live selectedAgentId with an edited-ref so manual input is never clobbered (PlayArea.tsx:45-56).

journeys.name: fund/harvest GAS rewards
journeys.detail: harvestRewards/fundRewards not exposed anywhere; mainnet rewardReserve for miniapp-profitanchor is 0 (RPC-verified), so ProfitAnchor stakers can never successfully claim.

journeys.name: register/rotate agent accounts
journeys.detail: registerAgent/setAgentAccount absent from the console; 21 agents exist on-chain (registered out-of-band) but rotation/recovery is impossible via UI.

journeys.name: non-admin opens the console
journeys.detail: No role check against admin()/getAppAdmin; all forms enabled; failure mode is the raw on-chain 'unauthorized' assert in a toast.

medium_low.title: No admin-role detection or read-only fallback for non-operators
medium_low.evidence: Console renders fully enabled for any wallet; getAppAdmin('miniapp-profitanchor')/admin() are never read; failures arrive as raw contract assert text.
medium_low.fix: Read getAppAdmin + admin() on load; if connected address matches neither, disable the command grid and show an operator-wallet-required banner with the expected address.

medium_low.title: Agent directory is the static bundle roster, not on-chain state
medium_low.evidence: PROFITANCHOR_AGENT_ACCOUNTS imported from the sibling app and rendered verbatim (PlayArea.tsx:217-231); candidate updates submitted from this very console never appear in the directory.
medium_low.fix: Read getAgent(appId,1..getAgentCount) and render account + current candidate + active flag; refresh after each action.

medium_low.title: Submit buttons have no loading spinner (regression vs trustanchor-admin)
medium_low.evidence: NeoButton receives disabled={...|| submitting} but not loading={...}; trustanchor-admin passes loading per action (its PlayArea.tsx:165-173). During the multi-second wallet round-trip all three cards just grey out with no progress affordance.
medium_low.fix: Track which action is in flight (string state instead of boolean) and pass loading={busyAction==='transferAgentNeo'} etc. to each NeoButton.

medium_low.title: Hardcoded English kicker and icon title
medium_low.evidence: CategoryIcon title="ProfitAnchor Admin" and ProfitAnchor Admin bypass t(); hook validation errors are English-only.
medium_low.fix: Add an appName key to messages.ts (en/zh) and use t() for both; localize hook errors.

purpose: Self-serve NEO voting anchor: register your own anchor, create 21 AA agent accounts, then let users stake NEO, redeem NEO, and claim GAS rewards.

journeys.name: register a custom anchor
journeys.detail: The platform manifest description and runtime.operations promise 'register' (registerCustomAnchorApp) — and the contract supports it permissionlessly (appAdmin witness + 1 GAS prepaid credit, PlatformAnchor.cs:147-158) — but main.tsx registers only stake/withdraw/claimRewards/refreshAnchor. There is no UI anywhere in the suite to register an anchor, deposit the 1-GAS fee credit, or pick a slug/nonce.

journeys.name: create/register the 21 AA agent accounts
journeys.detail: registerAgents is listed in neo-manifest.json runtime.operations but has no action, no form, and no admin app (locale copy 'Agent routing stays in the admin console' refers to a custom-anchor admin console that does not exist — trustanchor-admin/profitanchor-admin are hardwired to their own appIds). A registered custom anchor would sit at agentCount=0 forever with no in-product fix.

journeys.name: stake NEO into an existing anchor
journeys.detail: Anchor id (launch param or typed) -> regex validate -> NEO transfer memo 'stake:<anchorAppId>' -> contract auto-stake. Wiring matches the contract, but the post-write refresh is broken by the 1.5s event timeout (below), and there is no way to discover valid anchor ids — you must arrive via deep link or paste one.

journeys.name: redeem NEO / claim GAS
journeys.detail: withdraw/claimRewards calls match the ABI and scope to the typed anchor id; same stale-refresh problem; claim additionally depends on the anchor owner funding rewards, which has no surface.

journeys.name: discover anchors to stake in
journeys.detail: No browse/list of registered custom anchors (the contract emits AnchorAppRegistered events that could be listed); empty state only says 'Open a OneGate anchor link'.

medium_low.title: Anchor input pre-filled with a valid-shaped fake example id
medium_low.evidence: useState(anchorAppId || 'custom-anchor:team:nonce') seeds the example as a real value; it passes isValidAnchorId so Stake/Redeem/Claim enable immediately, and a first-time user can submit a NEO transfer to a non-existent anchor (reverts at the contract with a raw 'app not registered' assert).
medium_low.fix: Seed with '' and keep 'custom-anchor:team:nonce' as placeholder only; optionally verify the anchor exists (getAppMode > 0) on blur and gate the money buttons on that check.

medium_low.title: No anchor discovery or existence validation
medium_low.evidence: loadData reads totalStaked/rewardReserve/agentCount for whatever id is typed; an unregistered id just returns zeros (mode never checked via getAppMode), so the UI shows a plausible all-zero anchor instead of 'this anchor does not exist'. There is no list of registered anchors (AnchorAppRegistered events are queryable).
medium_low.fix: Call getAppMode(target) in loadData and set an explicit 'Anchor not registered' error state when 0; add a recent-anchors list from AnchorAppRegistered events via chain.listEvents.

medium_low.title: No credit recovery for over/failed deposits or the registration fee flow
medium_low.evidence: Neither NEO nor GAS credit (getCredit / withdrawCredit) is surfaced; the 1-GAS registration fee model is prepaid-GAS-credit based (PlatformAnchor.cs:156 ConsumeGasCredit), so any future register flow — and any bare deposit today — needs a credit view + refund path.
medium_low.fix: Add a small 'Contract credits' row (NEO + GAS via getCredit) with a recover button invoking withdrawCredit when nonzero.

medium_low.title: Client-side anchor-id regex is stricter than the contract, can lock out real anchors
medium_low.evidence: targetAnchorId enforces ^custom-anchor:[a-z0-9-]{1,24}:[a-z0-9-]{1,24}$ while the contract accepts any 1-64 char appId (ValidateAppId); an anchor registered by script with uppercase, longer segments, or a different prefix is permanently unreachable from this UI even for redeeming already-staked NEO.
medium_low.fix: Relax the gate for withdraw/claim/refresh to the contract rule (1-64 chars) and keep the strict pattern only as a soft warning for new stakes.

purpose: Prepare official Neo N3 / Neo X bridge handoff payloads (asset + MessageBridge) and track operation status in one console.

journeys.name: Prepare asset bridge handoff (both directions)
journeys.detail: Form (direction/amount/recipient with presets) → dispatch prepareAssetBridge → buildAssetBridgeIntent validates direction-aware target address (Neo X 0x40-hex vs N3 base58, bridgeConsole.ts:113-120) and strict decimal amount → JSON intent + timeline rendered, copy button works. Validation errors are localized and actionable. But the output is only JSON — nothing is signed or broadcast.

journeys.name: Actually move GAS across the bridge (deposit → confirmation → arrival)
journeys.detail: The app never invokes a wallet or contract. main.tsx:50-60 registers only local intent builders; manifest declares contracts:{} and read:blockchain only. The user must take the generated JSON to the external bridge site (resource link). For a DeFi-category app named 'Neo X Bridge', the core money journey exists only off-app, even though shared ChainService/evm-chain primitives could submit the n3→neox GAS transfer leg.

journeys.name: Prepare MessageBridge intent
journeys.detail: Target contract validated against direction's target chain, payload required, gasLimit ≥21000 integer-validated; intent JSON includes route/method/digest/SDK references. Local-only by design.

journeys.name: Track a bridge operation
journeys.detail: trackBridgeOperation (main.tsx:62-101) builds a purely local, deterministic timeline (buildStatusTimeline). The source tx hash is never verified via RPC; 'Bridge observation', 'Validator attestation' and 'Destination finalized' steps are permanently 'waiting'. It looks like live tracking but tracks nothing — despite read:blockchain permission and a declared api stateSource.

journeys.name: Resume from host operation panel / deeplink
journeys.detail: launchContext handler (PlayArea.tsx:174-281) maps bridgeAsset/bridgeMessage/trackBridgeOperation operations and aliases (txHash→sourceTx), prefills forms and auto-dispatches when params validate; signature dedup via handledLaunchRef.

medium_low.title: Timeline labels, operation titles and statuses are hardcoded English
medium_low.evidence: Strings 'Intent prepared', 'Source transaction', 'Validator attestation', 'Destination finalized', status 'Intent prepared' (line 210) and 'Message intent prepared' (line 279) bypass the locale system; zh users get a mixed-language status card.
medium_low.fix: Return locale keys from buildStatusTimeline/build*Intent and translate at render time in PlayArea (t(step.labelKey)), or pass ctx.t into the builders.

medium_low.title: Raw enum values shown untranslated in metrics strip and recent list
medium_low.evidence: {lastKind} renders 'asset'/'message' literally; recent-operation rows render operation.kind raw (line 693).
medium_low.fix: Map kind through t('assetBridge')/t('messageBridge') (short variants) before rendering.

medium_low.title: Source tx input accepts any text despite hash256 declaration
medium_low.evidence: sourceTx has no format validation; neo-manifest.json operation_panel declares the field as hash256. A typo'd hash still flips the first two timeline steps to done/active.
medium_low.fix: Validate /^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/ with an inline localized error, mirroring the address validation pattern already used.

medium_low.title: Preview placeholders use '--' instead of em-dash
medium_low.evidence: BridgeActionPreview values fall back to "--" (also lines 549-550, 610) while the rest of the fleet standardizes on '—'.
medium_low.fix: Replace "--" fallbacks with "—".

purpose: Create and operate price-triggered Morpheus automation triggers: live datafeed price, recipe builder, gateway registration, enable/disable.

journeys.name: Fetch live price (NEO/GAS/BTC)
journeys.detail: fetchCurrentPrice → useMorpheusDataFeed.getPrice → on-chain invokefunction getLatest on MorpheusDataFeed. Verified live: mainnet feed 0x03013f49 returns TWELVEDATA:NEO-USD = $2.185 with recordTimestamp 2026-06-12 00:26 UTC (fresh), GAS-USD and BTC-USD also HALT. Hero shows '—' before first fetch.

journeys.name: Build automation recipe
journeys.detail: Strict decimal target-price validation with an actionable localized error (useAutomationCopilot.ts:133-147); deterministic trigger request JSON viewable in the Details disclosure; copyable.

journeys.name: Register trigger with the live gateway
journeys.detail: POST /api/edge/automation-triggers → host proxy → live edge function which requires requireAuth + requirePrimaryWallet (platform/edge/functions/automation-triggers/index.ts:29-36). The app reads bearer tokens only from sessionStorage/localStorage (automationGateway.ts:64-99), but production miniapps run in a sandboxed iframe WITHOUT allow-same-origin (PlayAreaShared.tsx:1246-1250) where storage access throws — explicitly designed so miniapps cannot lift sb-access-token. Net effect with infra LIVE: unauthenticated POST → 401 → registration fails in the hosted app. It only succeeds standalone on the host origin, or degrades to the well-labeled local_automation_intent handoff when EDGE_BASE_URL is unset.

journeys.name: Refresh trigger list / enable-disable
journeys.detail: Same 401 wall in the sandboxed iframe. The UI logic itself is sound: handoff intents are excluded from the verified list, toggle locks with an explanatory note (verifyBeforeOperate), counts shown.

journeys.name: Manage multiple triggers (view, select, delete)
journeys.detail: The triggers array and a count badge exist, but no list UI is rendered — only latestTrigger is operable. The edge layer supports automation-trigger-delete/update/executions; none are exposed. A user with 3 triggers cannot see or operate the older two.

medium_low.title: Only the latest trigger is manageable; no trigger list or delete
medium_low.evidence: Status card binds latestTrigger only; triggers array surfaces solely as a count badge (automation-panel__count). Edge functions automation-trigger-delete/update/executions exist but are unused.
medium_low.fix: Render the triggers list with per-row enable/disable/delete and execution history; select a row to make it the active trigger.

medium_low.title: Action Name is free text with no discoverable vocabulary
medium_low.evidence: actionName input defaults to 'auto_repay_self_loan' with placeholder only; nothing tells a first-time user which action names the automation.upkeep workflow accepts, so registrations can silently target nonexistent actions.
medium_low.fix: Replace with a NeoSelect of supported workflow actions (or fetch the catalog from the gateway) and keep free text behind an 'advanced' toggle.

medium_low.title: Hero Trigger Status shows 'N/A' before any trigger exists
medium_low.evidence: latestTriggerState.get() returns t('notAvailable') ('N/A') when latestTrigger is null; PlayArea.tsx:44-45 statusLabel uses it first, so the hero badge reads 'N/A' instead of 'Ready'.
medium_low.fix: Return '' when no trigger so the PlayArea fallback chain resolves to t('apiIdle') ('Ready'), or use an em-dash.

medium_low.title: Cron schedule field unvalidated client-side
medium_low.evidence: schedule accepts any string; malformed cron only fails at the gateway with a server error message.
medium_low.fix: Validate a 5-field cron pattern locally with a localized error, or offer presets (hourly / every 6h / daily).

medium_low.title: 'Build Recipe' button lacks a loading state
medium_low.evidence: Fetch Price and Register both pass loading={...}; Build Recipe does not (it is sync today, but visually inconsistent on click).
medium_low.fix: Pass loading={isRequesting} or give instant visual feedback (success toast already exists via successKey).

purpose: Check in daily on-chain (0.001 GAS fee), track UTC streaks, and claim milestone GAS rewards (day 7: +1, day 14: +2).

journeys.name: Load status after connect
journeys.detail: Four parallel chain.reads (getCheckInStateForFrontend/getCheckinStatus/getUserStatsDetails/getPlatformStats) verified against BOTH deployed ABIs (testnet 0xaba84da2, mainnet 0xbd4f3646 — same generation, all methods+keys present; live mainnet getPlatformStats returns nextMidnight/checkInFee/totals). Eligibility and countdown are driven by the contract clock, not local Date math — correct per the contract-day caveat.

journeys.name: Daily check-in
journeys.detail: Single tx: GAS transfer with memo 'miniapp-dailycheckin:checkin' IS the check-in; waits for CheckedIn event; optimistic CTA lock + chain reconcile with event-value fallback. VERIFIED LIVE on mainnet via invokefunction simulation: transfer HALTs and emits CheckedIn — the default-network path is genuinely functional.

journeys.name: Claim milestone rewards
journeys.detail: claimRewards(user) (signature matches both ABIs) with waitForEvent RewardsClaimed; claim button shows the exact claimable amount and disables at zero; totals reconciled with monotonic max() guards against node lag.

journeys.name: Understand today's plan / schedule
journeys.detail: Today-plan card narrates exactly what the buttons will do this cycle (next streak, milestone impact, claim plan); milestone ladder, week grid, UTC clock and urgency-tinted countdown ring are all consistent with contract state. One of the best-explained apps in the fleet.

journeys.name: Review check-in history
journeys.detail: History is appended in-memory only on actions taken this session; a reload shows 'No check-ins yet' even for a user with months of on-chain CheckedIn events. The on-chain log is never hydrated.

medium_low.title: Recent-activity history is session-only despite on-chain events
medium_low.evidence: checkinHistory is a plain observable filled only by addHistory() during doCheckIn/claimRewards; loadAll never reads CheckedIn/RewardsClaimed events, so the history card is empty on every fresh open.
medium_low.fix: Hydrate the last ~10 CheckedIn/RewardsClaimed events for the connected wallet on loadAll via the shared event-listing composable (the app already consumes these events for confirmation).

medium_low.title: Eligibility defaults to true before first load — possible faulted check-in right after wallet connect
medium_low.evidence: chainCanCheckin starts true; doCheckIn's guard reads it before any chain read. If a user who already checked in today opens the app disconnected and clicks the enabled 'Check In Now', resolveUserHash connects and the transfer is attempted immediately — the contract faults it at wallet test-invoke (confusing raw error) instead of the friendly 'Wait for next' state.
medium_low.fix: After resolveUserHash performs a first-time connect inside doCheckIn, read getCheckinStatus before invoking; or start chainCanCheckin as null/unknown and disable the CTA until the first load completes.

medium_low.title: Dead duplicate component trees shipped in the app
medium_low.evidence: CheckinCalendar/RewardsSection/StreakDisplay plus the entire src/pages/index/* set are imported nowhere (PlayArea imports only CountdownTimer); two divergent StreakDisplay implementations exist.
medium_low.fix: Delete the unused components and pages/index tree to prevent future drift.

medium_low.title: Emoji/ASCII glyphs used as state icons in week grid and milestones
medium_low.evidence: Week slots render '✓'/'○' text glyphs and milestones render '✓'/'🔒' emoji while the rest of the fleet uses the lucide icon set; the lock emoji renders inconsistently across platforms.
medium_low.fix: Swap for lucide Check/Circle/Lock icons sized to the slot.

purpose: Hacker-bounty vaults: creators lock a GAS bounty behind a SHA-256 secret hash; challengers pay a difficulty-tier fee per break attempt (wrong guesses grow the pot); expired vaults are reclaimable by the creator.

journeys.name: Create vault (mainnet — the DEFAULT network)
journeys.detail: manifest pins neo-n3-mainnet to legacy contract 0x198bfccc whose createVault takes 7 params (receiptId) and which has NO onNEP17Payment. Verified live: GAS transfer with memo 'miniapp-unbreakablevault:create' FAULTs ('Method onNEP17Payment with 3 parameter(s) doesn't exist') and attemptBreak with 3 args FAULTs ('Method attemptBreak with 3 parameter(s) doesn't exist'). Funds cannot leave the wallet (fails at test-invoke), but both money journeys are dead on the default network.

journeys.name: Create vault (testnet)
journeys.detail: Secret hashed locally (sha256Hex), deposit-then-act via invokeWithPayment (deposit-confirmation polling, DepositConfirmedActionFailedError discrimination), createVault 6-arg matches the testnet ABI 0x78fbd57c, waits VaultCreated, auto-selects the new vault, clears the form, shows the confirmation banner with the id.

journeys.name: Evaluate a vault before paying the attempt fee
journeys.detail: Load Vault works, but the detail panel shows ONLY status + attempt fee. The bounty (the prize you would win), title, the creator's public hint, attempt count, expiry/days-left and winner are all fetched into vaultDetails but never rendered; catalog rows show only '#id' + raw status. A challenger literally cannot see what they are paying to win.

journeys.name: Attempt break (testnet)
journeys.detail: canAttempt gates on a loaded vault matching the typed id + status active; fee deposit (vault-specific attemptFee from chain, fallback 0.1) then attemptBreak; outcome from AttemptMade event slot 2; bounty paid atomically on success; secret cleared; vault + catalog reloaded. Non-refundable-fee warning copy is present.

journeys.name: Reclaim expired vault
journeys.detail: canReclaim derived from creator-match + claimable/expired status (reactive to wallet AND vault); claimExpiredVault(vaultId) matches BOTH network ABIs; waits VaultExpired; button appears only when applicable.

journeys.name: Increase bounty
journeys.detail: neo-manifest.json operation_panel advertises 'Increase Bounty' and both deployed contracts expose increaseBounty, but the app registers no action and renders no UI for it.

journeys.name: Find my older vaults to reclaim
journeys.detail: myVaults filters only the newest 12 vaults (MAX_RECENT_VAULTS); a creator whose vault scrolled past 12 newer ones cannot see it — reclaim requires remembering the raw id.

medium_low.title: Manifest-advertised 'Increase Bounty' journey has no action or UI
medium_low.evidence: operation_panel declares increaseBounty (supported by both deployed contracts: testnet increaseBounty(vaultId, amount)); main.tsx registers only loadVault/attemptBreak/settleVault/createVault and PlayArea has no top-up control.
medium_low.fix: Register an increaseBounty action (deposit memo 'miniapp-unbreakablevault:create'-style credit + increaseBounty(vaultId, amount), waitForEvent BountyIncreased) and add a small top-up input on the loaded active vault owned by anyone.

medium_low.title: 'My Vaults' only scans the 12 newest vaults — older vaults become unfindable
medium_low.evidence: loadMyVaults filters readRecentVaultDetails(chain, MAX_RECENT_VAULTS=12); vaults are sequential ids, so any vault older than the latest 12 disappears from the creator's list, breaking reclaim discoverability (vaultChain.ts:34).
medium_low.fix: Enumerate deeper for the creator filter (e.g. scan up to MAX_ENUMERATE=200 in batches) or hydrate from VaultCreated events filtered by the wallet's script hash.

medium_low.title: zh manifest description describes a different product than en
medium_low.evidence: description: 'Hacker bounty vaults secured by secret hashes' vs description_zh: '时间锁定资产保险箱，到期前任何人都无法取出' (a time-locked vault nobody can open before expiry) — the zh copy misstates the game mechanics; list/status values also render raw English ('active') in PlayArea.tsx:302,326.
medium_low.fix: Rewrite description_zh to match the bounty-game mechanics, and localize list statuses via the existing active/broken/expired/claimable keys.

medium_low.title: Event-wait timeout misreported as a failed break attempt
medium_low.evidence: success is derived from AttemptMade slot 2; when waitForEvent times out (indexer lag) result.event is null → success=false → user is told 'Attempt failed' (wrong-secret semantics) even if the tx HALTed and may have WON the bounty.
medium_low.fix: Distinguish event=null: show a 'confirming…' state and re-poll the vault details/winner before declaring the attempt failed.

medium_low.title: No secret confirmation on create — a typo locks the bounty until expiry
medium_low.evidence: Single password field for the secret; locale already defines confirmSecretLabel/confirmSecretPlaceholder/secretMismatch (messages.ts:23-25) but no confirm field is rendered. A mistyped secret means even the creator cannot break their own vault; funds are stuck until expiry reclaim.
medium_low.fix: Add the confirm-secret input and block submit on mismatch using the existing secretMismatch message.

medium_low.title: Create-form errors are generic and the 1-GAS minimum is undisclosed
medium_low.evidence: All validation failures throw t('vaultCreateFailed') ('Create failed'); minBountyNote and bountyPlaceholder keys exist unused; bounty placeholder hardcoded '10' (PlayArea.tsx:157); title/description silently truncated to 100/300 chars (lines 203-204).
medium_low.fix: Surface field-specific messages (use minBountyNote under the bounty input, t('bountyPlaceholder') as placeholder) and add maxLength + counters on title/description.

purpose: Help users discover the right miniapp via home showcase (/) and the market catalog (/miniapps) with search, category, status, and network-aware availability.

journeys.name: discover an app from the home page
journeys.detail: ISR-seeded list (getStaticProps revalidate 60) renders instantly, then refreshes from /api/miniapps/catalog with abort-timeout handling and pulse skeletons; search is deferred-value debounced; localized name/description/category all participate in the match; HomeMiniAppRow links preserve ?network=.

journeys.name: filter by category on a phone
journeys.detail: On the home page the entire category sidebar is `hidden ... lg:block` (pages/index.tsx:420) and no mobile substitute exists — phone users only get sort + search. They can still reach categories by navigating to /miniapps, which has visible category chips, but nothing tells them that.

journeys.name: judge whether an app is live on my network
journeys.detail: /miniapps rows show availability tone (live/pending/other-network/tool) with counts per quick filter, ping dot for live, network label per row; status chips derive from getMiniAppCatalogAvailability against the target network.

journeys.name: switch between testnet and mainnet while browsing
journeys.detail: Every page reads and propagates ?network= (Navbar/Footer/withNetworkQuery), but no UI control anywhere sets it — users must hand-edit the URL. See the wallet section finding; from the catalog side the network badge is display-only.

medium_low.title: Home page has no category filter on mobile
medium_low.evidence: The categories aside is `<aside className="hidden w-72 shrink-0 space-y-8 lg:block">`; below lg the only controls left are the sort row and search. Category discovery (gaming/defi/social/nft/governance/utility with counts) is desktop-only on the landing page.
medium_low.fix: Below lg, render the same categories as a horizontally scrollable chip row above the grid (reuse CategoryFilterButton in compact pill form), mirroring the chips already used on /miniapps:704-724.

medium_low.title: Leftover debug page /test ships in production routes

medium_low.fix: Generalize: when a HOST_WALLET_BRIDGE_RESULT arrives whose normalized operation matches the active console operation's resolved chain method (and same contractHash), apply the same disabled reason for N seconds / until next poll, instead of keying on one app id and memo.

medium_low.title: Account page claims 'Connected' while no wallet is connected, in English only, under a stray 'Yiwu' title

purpose: The postMessage wallet bridge that lets sandboxed (no allow-same-origin) miniapp iframes read chain state and request signing/invokes/transfers through the host wallet, with explicit user approval for sensitive methods.

journeys.name: embedded dApp reads chain state
journeys.detail: method 'call' routes to /api/rpc/neo invokefunction with normalized args; origin/window-identity checks accommodate the opaque-origin sandbox correctly; errors return structured {ok:false,error.message} to the frame.

medium_low.title: Bridge rejections surface nowhere in the host if the miniapp swallows them

medium_low.fix: When a SENSITIVE method fails or is rejected, also set a short-lived host notice (reuse invokeFeedback via a window CustomEvent like HOST_WALLET_BRIDGE_RESULT but for errors): 'Request rejected — nothing was submitted.'

journeys.name: Recover a stranded deposit credit (deposit-then-act apps)
journeys.detail: All deposit-then-act contracts were hardened with withdraw(account)+creditOf, and 4 apps wire it into the UI (red-envelope PlayArea.tsx:405 withdrawCredit button, gov-merc main.tsx:114, self-loan useSelfLoan.ts:772/798 withdraw+withdrawRepayCredit, dev-tipping PlayArea.tsx:86). But 6 apps whose contracts expose the same exit never invoke it: breakup-contract, burn-league, fogplay, last-survivor, on-chain-tarot, time-capsule (rg for "withdraw" invocations returns only comments/locale text). fogplay's own error copy even instructs the user to 'withdraw from your balance to recover the GAS' (locale/messages.ts:69) — an instruction the UI cannot fulfil. Credit auto-reuses on the NEXT paid action, so funds are not lost, but a user who stops playing has GAS locked with no exit.

journeys.name: Switch wallet language to Chinese
journeys.detail: en/zh key-count parity is exact in all 60 locale files (automated count of en: vs zh: entries — zero mismatches), and t() merges shared base-messages correctly. But private-transfer renders its entire 530-line PlayArea with ZERO t() calls — hero, form labels (Network/Asset/Recipient/Amount), presets, doc section and all seal-error strings are hardcoded English, so zh users get a fully English app. Separately, 10 i18n keys referenced in TSX exist in NO locale source (flashloan x5, fogplay, neo-convert, neo-pay-shared-example, neo-swap x2), and because useI18n t() returns the raw key for missing entries, users literally see 'eyebrow' / 'loadingBalances' / 'streamNotFound' on screen in BOTH languages.

journeys.name: Submit an async write and read the feedback (pending, success, error)
journeys.detail: Pending/double-submit protection is fleet-clean: a brace-aware scan of all 120 dispatch-bound buttons found only 2 write-shaped buttons without disabled/loading guards, and both are benign local actions (tarot flipCard, neo-swap direction toggle). 33 apps use notify.guard/guardResult, and sampled flows (graveyard useGraveyard.ts:280/467, gas-sponsor useGasSponsor.ts handleDonate→loadUserData, neo-swap executeSwap→refreshBalances) all refresh state after writes. Friction: ~20 apps surface raw error.message (RPC/VM text) to users, and time-capsule's two money-moving actions (openCapsule returns locked GAS, fishCapsule pays a fee) complete silently with no success toast.

journeys.name: First load on a 390px phone (layout + empty states)
journeys.detail: No app SCSS contains a fixed width >350px (only two min-width:960px media queries, which are desktop breakpoints, not overflow hazards). Sampled list renders either carry explicit empty-state copy (gasbox PlayArea.tsx:345 market-empty card, neo-multisig PlayArea.tsx:572 recentEmpty, event-ticket-pass emptyEvents/emptyTickets) or fall back to seeded defaults (neo-treasury founder watchlists). Focus-visible is covered fleet-wide by shared NeoButton.scss:33 — the 11 apps with no local :focus-visible rule use NeoButton exclusively (0 raw <button> elements except 2 in neo-message).

journeys.name: Visual consistency across the fleet (Neo Soft system)
journeys.detail: The eyebrow system (uppercase + letter-spacing) is present in every app with its own SCSS, and --ns-* token adoption is broad. Friction: 20+ apps re-declare 20-84 local hex design tokens that duplicate Neo Soft values instead of referencing var(--ns-*) (gas-sponsor 84, neo-swap 49, self-loan 46, on-chain-tarot 46), so a future token change will fork the fleet's appearance; several carry stale 'violet' token names bound to the green #0fb174 accent.

journeys.name: Token-amount math integrity (base units, no float)
journeys.detail: Conversion to base units is consistently routed through digit-string utilities (shared utils/format.ts toFixedDecimals/toFixed8, utils/amounts.ts gasToBaseUnits, aa-market-hub BigInt math); the many parseFloat sites are validation-only (e.g. fogplay useCoinFlip.ts:180 validates with a /\d{1,8}/ decimals regex before converting from the original string). One transactional float survives: neo-swap's slippage floor (useSwapEngine.ts:217-219) multiplies a float by 0.995 and stringifies it before toFixedDecimals — tiny outputs stringify to scientific notation, which toFixedDecimals rejects to "0", silently disabling slippage protection.

journeys.name: Stale copy vs current reality (oracle back up, hardened contracts)
journeys.detail: No 'coming soon' copy and no permanent degraded-infrastructure banners remain in locale files — all 'unavailable' strings found are conditional error states. The historical degradation notes survive only in code comments (dev-tipping, graveyard, memorial-shrine headers), which are invisible to users. OneGate references match the real host wallet SDK (apps/shared/utils/wallet-sdk.ts), so they are not stale branding.

medium_low.title: Raw Error.message (RPC/VM text) surfaced to users across ~20 apps; shared NotificationService institutionalizes it
medium_low.evidence: NotificationService.error(error, fallbackKey) emits error.message verbatim whenever error is an Error (lines 83-90), so chain/RPC strings like 'insufficient prepaid gas' or neon-js invoke failures reach toasts untranslated. The same `error instanceof Error ? error.message : t(fallback)` pattern is hand-rolled in unbreakable-vault PlayArea.tsx:74-107, trustanchor PlayArea.tsx:97/109 + main.tsx:120, profitanchor (4 sites), custom-anchor PlayArea.tsx:75, neo-treasury PlayArea.tsx:66, time-capsule main.tsx:43, dice-game main.tsx:265, plus stringify helpers in burn-league:95, gov-merc:112, self-loan:92, last-survivor:106. Good mappers already exist: gas-lucky-pool useGasLuckyPool.onegate.ts:92 normalizes timeouts, neodid-passport main.tsx:21 maps raw→friendly.
medium_low.fix: Add a shared mapChainError(error, t) that pattern-matches the known failure families (user rejected, insufficient GAS, deposit-confirmed-but-act-failed, RPC timeout, contract not configured) to i18n keys and falls back to a generic 'transactionFailed' key with the raw message in console.debug; switch NotificationService.error to use it, which fixes all guard/guardResult adopters in one place.

medium_low.title: Dead `t("key") || "English"` fallback anti-pattern in 15+ apps (hundreds of sites)
medium_low.evidence: Because t() never returns a falsy value (useI18n.ts:36 returns the key itself), every `t("x") || "English literal"` is unreachable code. Per-file counts in PlayArea.tsx alone: memorial-shrine 49, flashloan 46, self-loan 43, automation-copilot 39, recovery-guardian 37, timestamp-proof 32, neo-pay 29, aa-session-key-lab 28, aa-account-lab 28, unbreakable-vault 26, breakup-contract 26, time-capsule 24, neo-convert 24, wallet-health 23, aa-permissions-lab 21. The pattern actively masked the 10 genuinely-missing keys (see flashloan/fogplay finding) because authors trusted the fallback to render.
medium_low.fix: Strip the `|| "..."` fallbacks (mechanical codemod: `t("k") || "..."` → `t("k")`) after confirming each key exists; add a dev-mode console.warn in useI18n t() when a key is missing so future gaps surface in development instead of shipping raw keys.

medium_low.title: time-capsule reveal (returns locked GAS) and fish (pays fee) complete with no success feedback
medium_low.evidence: registerActions gives createCapsule successKey:"capsuleCreated", but fishCapsule (main.tsx:31-34) has only errorKey, and openCapsule (main.tsx:37-45) is a hand-rolled registerAction whose only feedback path is ctx.setStatus(...,"error"). A user who reveals a capsule — the action that returns their locked GAS — gets no confirmation toast; the only signal is the list re-render. This is the worst write-feedback gap in the fleet (write/success-feedback ratio scan: time-capsule 5 writes / 0 success signals).
medium_low.fix: Add successKey: "capsuleOpened" (en: 'Capsule revealed — locked GAS returned' / zh equivalent) and successKey: "capsuleFished" to the registerActions entries, and convert openCapsule to the same registerActions form so its success path emits a toast.

medium_low.title: 20+ apps maintain shadow palettes: local hex tokens duplicating Neo Soft values instead of var(--ns-*)
medium_low.evidence: on-chain-tarot defines 46 local custom properties with raw hex that mirror system values (--tarot-ink:#1e1e2e, --tarot-panel:#ffffff, --tarot-green:#0fb174) and only 9 var(--ns-) references; gas-sponsor 84 local hex tokens, neo-swap 49, self-loan 46, gasbox 44, last-survivor 39, flashloan 39, red-envelope 38, daily-checkin 38, gov-merc 34, burn-league 33, timestamp-proof 32 (and 9 more apps >20). Stale naming proves the drift: --tarot-violet is bound to green #0fb174 (PlayArea.scss:10), and even shared NeoButton.scss:33 reads `var(--ns-violet, #16c784)` — a violet-named token with a green fallback.
medium_low.fix: Re-point local theme tokens at the system: `--tarot-ink: var(--ns-ink)` etc., keeping only genuinely app-specific accents as literals; rename the violet-named green tokens (--ns-violet → --ns-accent with a deprecation alias) so the next palette change propagates fleet-wide instead of forking 20 apps.

medium_low.title: neo-swap slippage floor computed in float; tiny amounts collapse to 0 and disable protection
medium_low.evidence: executeSwap derives minOutputInt via `parseFloat(toAmount) * 0.995` then `toFixedDecimals(minOutputAmount.toString(), tt.decimals)` (lines 217-219). toFixedDecimals (apps/shared/utils/format.ts:75-88) rejects non-digit fractions, so a float that stringifies to scientific notation (e.g. 9.5e-8 for sub-1e-6 GAS outputs) returns "0" — the swap is then submitted with minOutput 0, i.e. unlimited slippage. The input amount itself is converted safely from the original string (line 216), so only the protection floor is affected.
medium_low.fix: Compute the floor in integer space: `const minOutputInt = ((BigInt(expectedOutputInt) * 995n) / 1000n).toString()` where expectedOutputInt is toFixedDecimals(toAmount.get(), tt.decimals) — no float, no scientific-notation path, and reject the swap if the result is 0.

medium_low.title: Hardcoded English eyebrows/kickers in 4 apps bypass i18n
medium_low.evidence: aa-session-key-lab PlayArea.tsx:223 `Session Keys`; neo-ns PlayArea.tsx:58 `NAME SERVICE`; trustanchor-admin PlayArea.tsx:121 `TrustAnchor Admin`; profitanchor-admin PlayArea.tsx:88 `ProfitAnchor Admin`. All four are user-visible header copy outside locale files in apps that otherwise translate everything; zh users see English eyebrows on otherwise-translated screens (product names alone would be acceptable, but 'Session Keys' and 'NAME SERVICE' are descriptive copy).
medium_low.fix: Move the four strings into each app's locale/messages.ts (e.g. heroEyebrow: { en: "Session Keys", zh: "会话密钥" }) and render via t(); keep pure product names (TrustAnchor, ProfitAnchor) inside the translated string so branding is preserved.
